Singularity.Algebra.GrMod.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → Ideal R → (M : Type v) → [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] → [Module R M] → Type v

Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomi.type:
∀ {f g : ℕ → ℤ} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f d →
    Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial g d → Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial (f + g) d

∀ {f : ℕ → ℤ} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f d →
    ∀ (k : ℕ), Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial (fun n => f (n + k)) d

∀ {f g : ℕ → ℤ} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f d →
    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, f n = g n) → Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial g d

∀ {f : ℕ → ℤ} {d : ℕ} {P : Polynomial ℚ},
  P.degree < ↑(d + 1) →
    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(f n) = Polynomial.eval (↑n) P) →
      ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑((fwdDiff 1)^[d] f n) = ↑d.factorial * P.coeff d

∀ {f : ℕ → ℤ} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f (d + 1) →
    ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (fwdDiff 1)^[d] f n = Singularity.Algebra.eventualValue ((fwdDiff 1)^[d] f)

∀ {f : ℕ → ℤ} {d e : ℕ},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f d → d ≤ e → Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f e

∀ {f : ℕ → ℤ} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f d → Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial (-f) d

∀ {f : ℕ → ℤ} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f d → ∀ (c : ℤ), Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial (c • f) d

∀ {f g : ℕ → ℤ} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f d →
    Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial g d → Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial (f - g) d

∀ {f : ℕ → ℤ} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial f d →
    Singularity.Algebra.IsEventuallyPolynomial (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f k) (d + 1)

∀ {f : ℕ → ℤ} {P Q : Polynomial ℚ},
  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(f n) = Polynomial.eval (↑n) P) →
    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(f n) = Polynomial.eval (↑n) Q) → P = Q

Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj.type:
{R : Type u} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    {N : Type v} → [inst_1 : AddCommGroup N] → [inst_2 : Module R N] → (ℕ → Submodule R N) → (ℕ → N →ₗ[R] N) → Prop

Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj.apply_.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {N : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_2 : Module R N] {𝒩 : ℕ → Submodule R N}
  {π : ℕ → N →ₗ[R] N},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj 𝒩 π →
    ⨆ n, 𝒩 n = ⊤ →
      ∀ (μ : N →ₗ[R] N), (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ 𝒩 n, μ y ∈ 𝒩 (n + 1)) → ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : N), (π (n + 1)) (μ y) = μ ((π n) y)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {N : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_2 : Module R N] {𝒩 : ℕ → Submodule R N}
  {π : ℕ → N →ₗ[R] N},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj 𝒩 π →
    ⨆ n, 𝒩 n = ⊤ → ∀ (μ : N →ₗ[R] N), (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ 𝒩 n, μ y ∈ 𝒩 (n + 1)) → ∀ (y : N), (π 0) (μ y) = 0

Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj.eq_sel.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {N : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_2 : Module R N] {𝒩 : ℕ → Submodule R N}
  {π : ℕ → N →ₗ[R] N}, Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj 𝒩 π → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ 𝒩 n, (π n) y = y

Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj.eq_zer.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {N : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_2 : Module R N] {𝒩 : ℕ → Submodule R N}
  {π : ℕ → N →ₗ[R] N}, Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj 𝒩 π → ∀ (n m : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ 𝒩 m, m ≠ n → (π n) y = 0

Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj.mem.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {N : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_2 : Module R N] {𝒩 : ℕ → Submodule R N}
  {π : ℕ → N →ₗ[R] N}, Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj 𝒩 π → ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : N), (π n) y ∈ 𝒩 n

Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj.sum.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {N : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_2 : Module R N] {𝒩 : ℕ → Submodule R N}
  {π : ℕ → N →ₗ[R] N},
  Singularity.Algebra.IsGradingProj 𝒩 π →
    ∀ (y : N), ∃ D, (∀ (n : ℕ), D < n → (π n) y = 0) ∧ y = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), (π n) y

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.aeval_X_add_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (a i)) f =
    (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval a)) ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor σ R) f)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (a : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (a i)) f =
    ∑ α ≤ f.support.sup id,
      (MvPolynomial.monomial α) ((MvPolynomial.eval a) ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f))

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_add_s.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} (β α : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ),
  Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose (β + Finsupp.single i 1) α =
    Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β α +
      if α i = 0 then 0 else Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β (α - Finsupp.single i 1)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_eq_pr.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} (β α : σ →₀ ℕ) {s : Finset σ},
  α.support ⊆ s → Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β α = ∏ i ∈ s, (β i).choose (α i)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_eq_ze.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {β α : σ →₀ ℕ}, Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β α = 0 ↔ ¬α ≤ β

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_modEq.type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {e n a : ℕ}, p ^ e ∣ n → ¬p ^ e ∣ a → n.choose a ≡ 0 [MOD p]

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_mod_p.type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (e n : ℕ), n.choose (n % p ^ e) ≡ 1 [MOD p]

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_ne_ze.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {β α : σ →₀ ℕ}, Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β α ≠ 0 ↔ α ≤ β

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_self.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (β : σ →₀ ℕ), Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β β = 1

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_singl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ) (n : ℕ),
  Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β (Finsupp.single i n) = (β i).choose n

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_tsub_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} (β α γ : σ →₀ ℕ),
  Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose (β - γ) α * Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β γ =
    Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose (α + γ) α * Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β (α + γ)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose_zero_.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (β : σ →₀ ℕ), Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β 0 = 1

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.coeff_aeval_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : σ → R) (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (a i)) f).coeff α =
    (MvPolynomial.eval a) ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.coeff_hasseD.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (α γ : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f).coeff γ =
    ↑(Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose (γ + α) α) * f.coeff (γ + α)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.coeff_taylor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor σ R) f).coeff α = (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (β α : σ →₀ ℕ),
  ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor σ R) ((MvPolynomial.monomial β) 1)).coeff α =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (β - α)) ↑(Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β α)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.constantCoef.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f) = f.coeff α

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.exists_expan.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {q : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (∃ g, (MvPolynomial.expand q) g = f) ↔ ∀ β ∈ f.support, ∀ (i : σ), q ∣ β i

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p] (e : ℕ)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (∃ g, (MvPolynomial.expand (p ^ e)) g = f) ↔
    ∀ (α : σ →₀ ℕ), α ≠ 0 → (∀ (i : σ), α i < p ^ e) → (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f = 0

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) (MvPolynomial.C r) = if α = 0 then MvPolynomial.C r else 0

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) (MvPolynomial.X i) =
    if α = 0 then MvPolynomial.X i else if α = Finsupp.single i 1 then 1 else 0

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv_a.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f = ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor σ R) f).coeff α

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv_c.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (α β : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv β) f) =
    Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose (α + β) α • (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv (α + β)) f

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (α β : σ →₀ ℕ),
  Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α ∘ₗ Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv β =
    Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose (α + β) α • Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv (α + β)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv_e.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {α : σ →₀ ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  ¬α ≤ f.support.sup id → (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f = 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p] (e : ℕ)
  {α : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ (i : σ), α i < p ^ e) →
    ∀ (g f : MvPolynomial σ R),
      (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) ((MvPolynomial.expand (p ^ e)) g * f) =
        (MvPolynomial.expand (p ^ e)) g * (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv_m.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (α β : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) ((MvPolynomial.monomial β) r) =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (β - α)) (↑(Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.choose β α) * r)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) (f * g) =
    ∑ x ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal α,
      (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv x.1) f * (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv x.2) g

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv_s.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv (Finsupp.single i 1)) f = (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv_z.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R], Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv 0 = LinearMap.id

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv 0) f = f

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.induction_ad.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {P : (σ →₀ ℕ) → Prop},
  P 0 → (∀ (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ), P β → P (β + Finsupp.single i 1)) → ∀ (β : σ →₀ ℕ), P β

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.le_ord_aeval.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : σ → R) {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ},
  ↑d ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (a i)) f) ↔
    ∀ (α : σ →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree α < d → (MvPolynomial.eval a) ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f) = 0

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.le_ord_iff_h.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ},
  ↑d ≤ Singularity.ord f ↔
    ∀ (α : σ →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree α < d → MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f) = 0

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.linearMap_ex.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {M : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] M},
  (∀ (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R), φ ((MvPolynomial.monomial β) r) = ψ ((MvPolynomial.monomial β) r)) → φ = ψ

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.natCast_eq_o.type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [CharP R p] {n : ℕ}, n ≡ 1 [MOD p] → ↑n = 1

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.natCast_eq_z.type: ∀ (p : ℕ) {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [CharP R p] {n : ℕ}, n ≡ 0 [MOD p] → ↑n = 0

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor.type: (σ : Type u_1) → (R : Type u_2) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r : R),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor σ R) (MvPolynomial.C r) = MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.C r)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor σ R) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X i) + MvPolynomial.X i

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor_eq_su.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.taylor σ R) f =
    ∑ α ≤ f.support.sup id, (MvPolynomial.monomial α) ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f)

Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.uniqueAlgEqu.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Unique σ] (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv R σ) ((Singularity.Algebra.MvHasse.hasseDeriv α) f) =
    (Polynomial.hasseDeriv (α default)) ((MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv R σ) f)

Singularity.Algebra.adjoin_range_grGen.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {M : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {r : ℕ}
  {x : Fin r → R} (hI : I = Ideal.span (Set.range x)), Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range (Singularity.Algebra.grGen M hI)) = ⊤

Singularity.Algebra.aeval_eq_sum_finsupp.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {σ : Type u_1} [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {n : ℕ},
  P.IsHomogeneous n →
    ∀ (g : σ → R), (MvPolynomial.aeval g) P = ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.finsuppAntidiag n, P.coeff s * s.prod fun i e => g i ^ e

Singularity.Algebra.aeval_mem_mul_pow.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {I J : Ideal R} {g : σ → R},
  (∀ (i : σ), g i ∈ I) →
    ∀ {P : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ},
      P.IsHomogeneous n → (∀ (s : σ →₀ ℕ), P.coeff s ∈ J) → (MvPolynomial.aeval g) P ∈ J * I ^ n

Singularity.Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid_.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (p : Ideal R) [inst_1 : p.IsPrime],
  Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (R ⧸ p) p.primeCompl = nonZeroDivisors (R ⧸ p)

Singularity.Algebra.algebraMap_away_inje.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {x : R},
  x ≠ 0 → Function.Injective ⇑(algebraMap R (Localization.Away x))

Singularity.Algebra.algebraMap_mem_map_o.type:
∀ {A : Type u} [inst : CommRing A] (q : Ideal A) [inst_1 : q.IsPrime] (I : Ideal A) {g y : A},
  g ∉ q → g * y ∈ I → (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q)) y ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q)) I

Singularity.Algebra.artinRees.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] [IsNoetherianRing R]
  [Module.Finite R M] (I : Ideal R) (N : Submodule R M), ∃ c, ∀ n ≥ c, I ^ n • ⊤ ⊓ N = I ^ (n - c) • (I ^ c • ⊤ ⊓ N)

Singularity.Algebra.artinRees_le.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] [IsNoetherianRing R]
  [Module.Finite R M] (I : Ideal R) (N : Submodule R M),
  ∃ c, ∀ n ≥ c, I ^ n • N ≤ I ^ n • ⊤ ⊓ N ∧ I ^ n • ⊤ ⊓ N ≤ I ^ (n - c) • N

Singularity.Algebra.basicOpen_subset_reg.type:
∀ {D S : Type u} [inst : CommRing D] [IsNoetherianRing D] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : Algebra D S] [Module.Flat D S]
  [Algebra.IsIntegral D S],
  Function.Injective ⇑(algebraMap D S) →

Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → Ideal R → (M : Type v) → [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] → [Module R M] → ℕ → ℕ

Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity_a.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {M : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R M] {J : Ideal R},
  I ≤ J →
    ∀ {r s : ℕ} {x : Fin r → R} {z : Fin s → R},
      I = Ideal.span (Set.range x) →
        J = Ideal.span (Set.range z) →
          Module.length R (M ⧸ I • ⊤) ≠ ⊤ →
            ∀ {d : ℕ},
              r ≤ d →
                s ≤ d → Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity J M d ≤ Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity I M d

Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity_d.type:
∀ (R : Type u) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : IsDiscreteValuationRing R],
  Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R 1 = 1

Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity_e.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {M : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {d : ℕ}
  {P : Polynomial ℚ},
  P.natDegree ≤ d →
    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(Singularity.Algebra.hilbertSamuel I M n).toNat = Polynomial.eval (↑n) P) →
      ↑(Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity I M d) = ↑d.factorial * P.coeff d

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {M : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {d c : ℕ},
  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (fwdDiff 1)^[d] (Singularity.Algebra.hilbertSamuelInt I M) n = ↑c) →
    Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity I M d = c

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {M : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {d : ℕ}
  {P : Polynomial ℚ},
  P.natDegree < d →
    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(Singularity.Algebra.hilbertSamuel I M n).toNat = Polynomial.eval (↑n) P) →
      Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity I M d = 0

Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity_f.type: ∀ (K : Type u) [inst : Field K], Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal K) K 0 = 1

Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity_p.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {M : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M]

      Module.length R (M ⧸ I • ⊤) ≠ ⊤ →
        ∀ {P : Polynomial ℚ},
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(Singularity.Algebra.hilbertSamuel I M n).toNat = Polynomial.eval (↑n) P) →
            0 < Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity I M P.natDegree

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {M : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {P : Polynomial ℚ},
  P ≠ 0 →
    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(Singularity.Algebra.hilbertSamuel I M n).toNat = Polynomial.eval (↑n) P) →
      0 < Singularity.Algebra.samuelMultiplicity I M P.natDegree

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {I : Ideal R}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {x : R},

Singularity.ContinuousFamily.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type u_2} →
      [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] →
        Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀ → (ι : Type u_3) → [LinearOrder ι] → Type (max (max u_1 u_2) u_3)

Singularity.ContinuousFamily.IsLimitKeyP.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type u_2} →
      [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] →
        {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} →
          {ι : Type u_3} → [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] → Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι → Polynomial K → Prop

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
    (∀ (i : ι), F.value i ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) →
      ∀ [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
        (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
          ∀ {φ : Polynomial K},
            F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
              ∀ {γ : Γ₀}, (∀ (i : ι), γ ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) φ) → γ = 0

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {φ : Polynomial K} [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    ∀ {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
      (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) →
        (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
          ((∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.natDegree ≤ φ.natDegree → F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ (ν φ) f = ν f) ↔
            ∀ (ψ : Polynomial K), ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → ν φ ≤ ν ψ)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀} [inst_3 : Nonempty ι] [inst_4 : NoMaxOrder ι] (hφ : F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ)
  (hγ : ∀ (i : ι), γ ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) φ),
  Singularity.KeyPolynomial (F.limitAugmentedValuation φ γ hφ hγ) φ

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀} [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    ∀ {w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
      (∀ (f : Polynomial K), w f = F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ f) → Singularity.KeyPolynomial w φ

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  [Nonempty ι] {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    ∀ (f g : Polynomial K),
      F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ (f + g) ≤
        max (F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ f) (F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ g)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
    (∀ (i : ι), F.value i ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) →
      ∀ [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
        (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
          (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) →
            ∀ {φ : Polynomial K},

Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoint.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin 3) × MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly_H1.type:

        f =
          (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c))) 1 *
            q

Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly_H2.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},

      0 ∈ S →
        ∀ f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianCenter {1, 2} S (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c),
          ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ (a - 1 + 1),
            f =
              (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c)))

Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly_eq_mo.type:

Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly_eq_mu.type:

Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly_mem_p.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ},

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a c : ℕ},

Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly_ne_ze.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c : ℕ), Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c ≠ 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly_notMe.type:

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → Finset (Fin 3) × MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint_i.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRun_end.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    a < p →
      ∀ (b c : ℕ) {ch : ℕ → Bool},
        Singularity.CornerCurves.IsCurveRun p a b c ch →
          ∃ N ≤ (b + c) / (p - a),
            (∀ k < N,
                Singularity.CornerCurves.CenterRhoStep p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveCenter (ch k)) (a - 1)
                  (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k)
                  (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch (k + 1))) ∧
              a + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N).1 < p ∧
                a + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N).2 < p ∧
                  Singularity.ordAlong {0, 1} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 < ↑p ∧
                    Singularity.ordAlong {0, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 < ↑p ∧
                      (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 ∉
                          Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑{0, 1}) ^ p ∧
                        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 ∉
                            Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑{0, 2}) ^ p ∧
                          Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).1
                              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 =
                            ↑(a - 1)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRun_of_cha.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p < a →
      ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool),
        (∀ (k : ℕ),
            Singularity.CornerCurves.CenterRhoStep p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveCenter (ch k)) (a - 1)
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k)
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch (k + 1))) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ),
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k).1
                  (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k).2 =
                ↑(a - 1)) ∧
            Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRun_of_le.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool),
      (∀ (k : ℕ),
          Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k).1
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k).2 =
            ↑(a - 1)) ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k) →
            Singularity.CornerCurves.CenterRhoStep p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveCenter (ch k)) (a - 1)
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k)
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch (k + 1))

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq.type: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq.eq_def.type:
∀ (p a b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (x : ℕ),
  Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch x =
    match x with
    | 0 => (b, c)
    | k.succ => Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepData p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_length.type:
∀ {p a : ℕ},
  a < p →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) {N : ℕ},
      (∀ k < N, Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k)) →
        N ≤ (b + c) / (p - a)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_succ.type:

    Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepData p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_sum_ad.type:
∀ {p a : ℕ},
  a < p →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (N : ℕ),
      (∀ k < N, Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k)) →
        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N).1 + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N).2 +
            N * (p - a) =
          b + c

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_sum_lt.type:
∀ {p a : ℕ},
  p < a →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
      (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).1 + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).2 <
        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).1 +
          (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).2

∀ {p a : ℕ},
  a < p →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k) →
        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).1 +
            (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).2 <
          (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).1 + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).2

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_sum_su.type:
∀ {p a : ℕ},
  a < p →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k) →
        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).1 +
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).2 +
            (p - a) =
          (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).1 + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).2

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepData.type: ℕ → ℕ → Bool → ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK.type: ℕ → ℕ → Bool → ℕ × ℕ → Prop

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStep_lt.type: ∀ {p a b : ℕ}, a < p → p ≤ a + b → a + b - p < b

Singularity.CornerCurves.curve_hG.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : ℕ), ∀ i ∈ {1, 2}, ∃ d ∈ (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ a).support, d i = 0

∀ {p a : ℕ},

          ¬Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch N) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N)

Singularity.CornerCurves.isClean_curvePo.type:

Singularity.CornerCurves.logJacobianOrde.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {N : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, N i = 0) →
    (∀ β ∈ g'.support, N ≤ β) →
      ∀ {w : MvPolynomial σ k},
        (MvPolynomial.monomial N) 1 * w ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g' →
          MvPolynomial.constantCoeff w ≠ 0 → Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = 0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) {S : Finset (Fin 3)},
      0 ∈ S →
        Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ p →
          ∀ {j : Fin 3},
            j ∈ S →
              ∀ (t : Fin 3 → ZMod p) {g' : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)},
                (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
                    MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
                  Singularity.cleanPart p g' ≠ 0 ∧
                    Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} S j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                      ↑(a - 1)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + b →
      ∀ (c : ℕ) {j : Fin 3},
        j ∈ {0, 1} →
          ∀ (t : Fin 3 → ZMod p) {g' : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)},
            (Singularity.centerChart {0, 1} j t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
                MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
              Singularity.cleanPart p g' ≠ 0 ∧
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 1} j t)
                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                  ↑(a - 1)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a c : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + c →
      ∀ (b : ℕ) {j : Fin 3},
        j ∈ {0, 2} →
          ∀ (t : Fin 3 → ZMod p) {g' : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)},
            (Singularity.centerChart {0, 2} j t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =

                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 2} j t)
                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a → ∀ (b c : ℕ), Singularity.logJacobianOrder {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) = ↑(a - 1)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →

      ∀ (c : ℕ),
        (Singularity.centerChart {0, 1} 0 0) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
            MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p * Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p (a + b - p) b c ∧
          Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 1} 0 0 = {0, 1, 2} ∧
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0, 1, 2}
                (Singularity.cleanPart p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p (a + b - p) b c)) =
              0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + b →
      ∀ (c : ℕ) {t : Fin 3 → ZMod p},
        t 1 ≠ 0 →
          (Singularity.centerChart {0, 1} 0 t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
              MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p *
                (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a + b - p) * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ c *
                  (MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.C (t 1)) ^ b) ∧
            Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 1} 0 t = {0, 2} ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0, 2}
                  (Singularity.cleanPart p
                    (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a + b - p) * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ c *
                      (MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.C (t 1)) ^ b)) =
                0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a c : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + c →
      ∀ (b : ℕ),
        (Singularity.centerChart {0, 2} 0 0) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
            MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p * Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p (a + c - p) b c ∧
          Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 2} 0 0 = {0, 1, 2} ∧
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0, 1, 2}
                (Singularity.cleanPart p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p (a + c - p) b c)) =
              0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a c : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + c →
      ∀ (b : ℕ) {t : Fin 3 → ZMod p},
        t 2 ≠ 0 →
          (Singularity.centerChart {0, 2} 0 t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
              MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p *
                (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a + c - p) * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ b *
                  (MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.C (t 2)) ^ c) ∧
            Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 2} 0 t = {0, 1} ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0, 1}
                  (Singularity.cleanPart p
                    (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a + c - p) * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ b *
                      (MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.C (t 2)) ^ c)) =
                0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + b →
      ∀ (c : ℕ) {t : Fin 3 → ZMod p},
        t 0 ≠ 0 →
          (Singularity.centerChart {0, 1} 1 t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
              MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ p *
                (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ (a + b - p) * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ c *
                  (MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C (t 0)) ^ a) ∧
            Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 1} 1 t = {1, 2} ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder {1, 2}
                  (Singularity.cleanPart p
                    (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ (a + b - p) * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ c *
                      (MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C (t 0)) ^ a)) =
                0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a c : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + c →
      ∀ (b : ℕ) {t : Fin 3 → ZMod p},
        t 0 ≠ 0 →
          (Singularity.centerChart {0, 2} 2 t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
              MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ p *
                (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ b * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ (a + c - p) *

            Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 2} 2 t = {1, 2} ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder {1, 2}
                  (Singularity.cleanPart p
                    (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ b * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ (a + c - p) *
                      (MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C (t 0)) ^ a)) =
                0

Singularity.CornerCurves.orderGAlong_cur.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},

Singularity.CornerCurves.pderiv_X_add_C_.type:

  i ≠ j → ∀ (s : ZMod p) (n : ℕ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C s) ^ n) = 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.pderiv_X_zero_p.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {i : Fin 3}, i ≠ 0 → ∀ (a : ℕ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ a) = 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.pderiv_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {N : σ →₀ ℕ} {i : σ},
  N i = 0 → ∀ (c : k), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial N) c) = 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.pderiv_zero_X_p.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv 0) (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ a) = ↑a * MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a - 1)

Singularity.CornerCurves.residualFactor_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c : ℕ),
  Singularity.residualFactor {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) = MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ a

Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData.mk.inj.type:
∀ {a b mu lam a_1 b_1 mu_1 lam_1 : ℕ},
  { a := a, b := b, mu := mu, lam := lam } = { a := a_1, b := b_1, mu := mu_1, lam := lam_1 } →
    a = a_1 ∧ b = b_1 ∧ mu = mu_1 ∧ lam = lam_1

∀ (a b mu lam a_1 b_1 mu_1 lam_1 : ℕ),
  ({ a := a, b := b, mu := mu, lam := lam } = { a := a_1, b := b_1, mu := mu_1, lam := lam_1 }) =
    (a = a_1 ∧ b = b_1 ∧ mu = mu_1 ∧ lam = lam_1)

Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData.mk.siz.type: ∀ (a b mu lam : ℕ), sizeOf { a := a, b := b, mu := mu, lam := lam } = 1 + sizeOf a + sizeOf b + sizeOf mu + sizeOf lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData.noConf.type: Sort u → Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData → Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData → Sort u

Singularity.CornerRuns.X_mul_pderiv_one_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 1 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 1) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam) =
    ↑(mu + p) * Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.X_mul_pderiv_two_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 2 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 2) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam) =
    ↑(lam + p) * Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE2_ne_corne.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE2 p D ≠ Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE1 p D

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → ℕ → ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG_eq.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p mu lam =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single 0 p)) 1 +
      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single 1 (mu + p) + Finsupp.single 2 (lam + p))) 1

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → ℕ → ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint.type:
(p : ℕ) →
  [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData → Finset (Fin 3) × MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly_eq_mon.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE1 p D)) 1 +
      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE2 p D)) 1

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly_eq_mul.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single 1 D.a + Finsupp.single 2 D.b)) 1 *
      Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p D.mu D.lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly_ne_zer.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData), Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D ≠ 0

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRun.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k)
        (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate (k + 1))) ∧
    (∀ (k : ℕ),
        Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k).1
            (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k).2 =
          ↑p) ∧
      Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → Finset (Fin 3) × MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint_in.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool), Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRun_of_char.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool),
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k)
        (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c (k + 1))) ∧
    (∀ (k : ℕ),
        Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k).1
            (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k).2 =
          ↑p) ∧
      Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRun_orderGA.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin 3)),
  ¬(0 ∈ S ∧ (1 ∈ S ∨ 2 ∈ S)) →
    Singularity.orderGAlong p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k).1 S
        (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k).2 <
      ↑p

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRun_two.type:
(∀ (k : ℕ),
    Singularity.RhoStep 2 2 (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k)
      (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate (k + 1))) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k).1
          (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k).2 =
        2) ∧
    Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_modEq.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  ↑(Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a * (↑(Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).lam + ↑p) -
      ↑(Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b * (↑(Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).mu + ↑p) ≡
    -1 [ZMOD ↑p]

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_not_dvd.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  ¬(p ∣ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a ∧ p ∣ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b) ∧
    ¬(p ∣ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a + (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).mu + p ∧
        p ∣ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b + (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).lam + p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_spec.type:
∀ (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).IsGood ∧
    1 ≤ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a ∧ 1 ≤ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_succ.type:
∀ (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c (k + 1) =
    if c k = true then (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).y else (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).z

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_sum_lt.type:
∀ (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a + (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b <
    (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c (k + 1)).a + (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c (k + 1)).b

Singularity.CornerRuns.corner_hG.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  ∀ i ∈ {1, 2}, ∃ d ∈ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p mu lam).support, d i = 0

Singularity.CornerRuns.divisorExponent_c.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.divisorExponent {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) =
    Finsupp.single 1 D.a + Finsupp.single 2 D.b

Singularity.CornerRuns.isClean_cornerPol.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → Singularity.IsClean p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D)

Singularity.CornerRuns.le_ord_cornerM.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ), ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam)

Singularity.CornerRuns.le_ord_cornerPoly.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D)

Singularity.CornerRuns.logJacobianOrder_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → Singularity.logJacobianOrder {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) = ↑p

Singularity.CornerRuns.lt_ord_cornerM.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ), ↑p < Singularity.ord (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam)

Singularity.CornerRuns.not_X_dvd_cornerP.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → ∀ (h : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)), ¬MvPolynomial.X 0 ∣ Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D + h ^ p

Singularity.CornerRuns.not_dvd_and_dvd_a.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData}, D.IsGood → ¬(p ∣ D.a ∧ p ∣ D.b)

∀ {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → ¬(p ∣ D.a + D.mu + p ∧ p ∣ D.b + D.lam + p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.ord_residualFacto.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D)) = ↑p

Singularity.CornerRuns.orderGAlong_corne.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood →
    ∀ (S : Finset (Fin 3)),
      ¬(0 ∈ S ∧ (1 ∈ S ∨ 2 ∈ S)) → Singularity.orderGAlong p {1, 2} S (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) ≤ 1

Singularity.CornerRuns.pderiv_zero_corne.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv 0) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam) = 0

Singularity.CornerRuns.pointChart_corner.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  (Singularity.pointChart 1 0) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) =
    MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ p * Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D.y

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  (Singularity.pointChart 2 0) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) =
    MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ p * Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D.z

Singularity.CornerRuns.residualFactor_co.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.residualFactor {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) =
    Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p D.mu D.lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.residualLogJacobi.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood →
    Singularity.residualLogJacobian {1, 2} (Finsupp.single 1 D.a + Finsupp.single 2 D.b)
        (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p D.mu D.lam) =
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p, Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p D.mu D.lam}

Singularity.CornerRuns.rhoStep_cornerPoi.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint p D) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint p D.y)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint p D) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint p D.z)

Singularity.CornerRuns.rhoStep_cornerRun.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k)
    (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c (k + 1))

Singularity.CurveRuns.X_mul_pderiv_one_m.type:
∀ (a b c : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 1 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 1) (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c) =
    ↑b * Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c

Singularity.CurveRuns.X_mul_pderiv_two_m.type:
∀ (a b c : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 2 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 2) (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c) =
    ↑c * Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c

Singularity.CurveRuns.X_mul_pderiv_zero_.type:
∀ (a b c : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 0 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 0) (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c) =
    ↑a * Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c

Singularity.CurveRuns.coeff_mono_add_mon.type:
∀ {a b c a' b' c' : ℕ},
  ¬(a = a' ∧ b = b' ∧ c = c') →
    (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a' b' c').coeff
        (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.expo a b c) =
      1

Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG_support.type: ∀ {k : ℕ}, ∀ i ∈ {1}, ∃ d ∈ MvPolynomial.support (Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG k), d i = 0

Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoly_eq.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoly k =
    Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono 4 (2 * k + 1) 0 + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono 2 (3 * k + 1) 3

Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoly_eq_mul.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoly k =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.expo 0 (2 * k + 1) 0)) 1 * Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG k

Singularity.CurveRuns.curveRun.type:
(∀ (k : ℕ), Singularity.RhoStep 2 4 (Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint k) (Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint (k + 1))) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint k).1 (Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint k).2 = 4) ∧
    Function.Injective Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint

Singularity.CurveRuns.isClean_mono_add_m.type:
∀ {a b c a' b' c' : ℕ},
  ¬(2 ∣ a ∧ 2 ∣ b ∧ 2 ∣ c) →
    ¬(2 ∣ a' ∧ 2 ∣ b' ∧ 2 ∣ c') →
      Singularity.IsClean 2
        (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a' b' c')

Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedG_support.type: ∀ i ∈ {0, 2}, ∃ d ∈ MvPolynomial.support Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedG, d i = 0

Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoly_eq.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoly k =
    Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono (5 + 3 * k) 2 3 + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono (10 + 3 * k) 3 2

Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedRun.type:
(∀ (k : ℕ),
    Singularity.RhoStep 2 3 (Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint k) (Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint (k + 1))) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint k).1 (Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint k).2 =
        3) ∧
    Function.Injective Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint

Singularity.CurveRuns.le_ord_mono.type: ∀ {n a b c : ℕ}, n ≤ a + b + c → ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c)

Singularity.CurveRuns.le_ord_natCast_mul.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {f : Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.Poly},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord f → ∀ (m : ℕ), ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord (↑m * f)

Singularity.CurveRuns.mono_add_mono_ne_z.type:
∀ {a b c a' b' c' : ℕ},
  ¬(a = a' ∧ b = b' ∧ c = c') →
    Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a' b' c' ≠ 0

Singularity.CurveRuns.ord_curve_ey.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.ord
      (↑((Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.expo 0 (2 * k + 1) 0) 1) • Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG k +
        MvPolynomial.X 1 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 1) (Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG k)) =
    ↑4

Singularity.CurveRuns.ord_isolated_ez.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.ord
      (↑((Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.expo (5 + 3 * k) 0 2) 2) • Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedG +
        MvPolynomial.X 2 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 2) Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedG) =
    ↑3

Singularity.CurveRuns.ord_mono.type: ∀ (a b c : ℕ), Singularity.ord (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c) = ↑(a + b + c)

Singularity.Curves.coe_normalLocus.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral X]
  (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k) [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f],
  topologicalKrullDim ↥X ≤ 1 → ↑(Singularity.Curves.normalLocus X) = Singularity.regularLocus X

Singularity.Curves.dimensionLEOne_of_rin.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R], ringKrullDim R ≤ 1 → Ring.DimensionLEOne R

Singularity.Curves.exists_isIntegrallyCl.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral X]
  (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k) [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f],
  topologicalKrullDim ↥X ≤ 1 →
    ∀ {x : ↥X},
      x ∈ Singularity.regularLocus X →
        ∃ V, AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V))

Singularity.Curves.finiteType_sectionAlg.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k)
  [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f] (U : X.Opens),
  AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U → Algebra.FiniteType k ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))

Singularity.Curves.finite_integralClosur.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) [inst_1 : AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral X]
  (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k) [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f] (U : X.Opens),
  AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U →
    ∀ [Nonempty ↥↑U],
      Module.Finite ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))
        ↥(integralClosure ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))
            ↑((AlgebraicGeometry.Spec X.functionField).presheaf.obj
                (Opposite.op ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map (Singularity.Curves.genericHom X).base).obj U))))

Singularity.Curves.genericAlgEquiv.type:
(X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) →
  [inst : AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral X] →
    (U : X.Opens) →
      [inst_1 : Nonempty ↥↑U] →
        ↑X.functionField ≃ₐ[↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))]

                          (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k

                          (V.comap

Singularity.KeyPolynomial.augmentedValua.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ →
    Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ ψ →
      ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree →
        γ ≤ μ φ →
          γ ≤ μ ψ →
            μ (ψ - φ) ≤ γ →
              ∀ (f : Polynomial K),
                Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f = Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ ψ γ f

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ →
    γ ≤ μ φ →
      ∀ (f g : Polynomial K),
        Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ (f * g) =
          Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f * Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ g

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ →
    γ ≤ μ φ →
      ∀ {f : Polynomial K},
        Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f ≠ 0 →
          Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ
              (f -
                ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1) with
                  μ (Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j) * γ ^ j = Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f,
                  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j * φ ^ j) <
            Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀} (hφ : Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ) (hγ : γ ≤ μ φ)
  {c : ℕ → Polynomial K} {N : ℕ},
  (∀ j < N, (c j).degree < φ.degree) →
    (Singularity.augmentedValuation μ φ γ hφ hγ) (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, c j * φ ^ j) =
      (Finset.range N).sup fun j => μ (c j) * γ ^ j

  {f : Polynomial K},
  (Singularity.augmentedValuation μ φ γ hφ hγ) f ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.MuEquiv (Singularity.augmentedValuation μ φ γ hφ hγ) f
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1) with
        μ (Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j) * γ ^ j = (Singularity.augmentedValuation μ φ γ hφ hγ) f,

  (∀ (a h : Γ), a ∉ H → 0 < a → h ∈ H → 0 < a + h) →

Singularity.MonomialValuation.exists_eq_.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {V : ValuationSubring K} [inst_4 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {x : ι → K},
  Singularity.IsMonomialValuation k V x →
    ∀ {z : K},
      z ≠ 0 →
        ∃ c a F G,
          c ≠ 0 ∧
            V.valuation F < 1 ∧
              V.valuation G < 1 ∧ z * (1 + G) = (algebraMap k K) c * Singularity.laurentMonomial x a * (1 + F)

Singularity.MonomialValuation.exists_exp.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {k : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Field k]
  [inst_3 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K} [inst_4 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {x : ι → K},
  Singularity.IsMonomialValuation k V x →
    ∀ {z : K},
      z ∈ V →
        ∃ E,
          (∀ a ∈ E, V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) ≤ 1) ∧
            ∀ (S : Subalgebra k K),
              (∀ a ∈ E, Singularity.laurentMonomial x a ∈ S) → ∃ f g, f ∈ S ∧ g ∈ S ∧ V.valuation g = 1 ∧ z * g = f

Singularity.MonomialValuation.exists_lea.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {k : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Field k]
  [inst_3 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K} [inst_4 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {y : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), y i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial y a) = 1 → a = 0) →
      ∀ {f : MvPolynomial ι k},
        f ≠ 0 →
          ∃ c α D F,
            c ≠ 0 ∧
              (MvPolynomial.aeval y) f = (algebraMap k K) c * Singularity.laurentMonomial y α * (1 + F) ∧
                (∀ a ∈ D, V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial y a) < 1) ∧
                  (∀ (S : Subalgebra k K), (∀ a ∈ D, Singularity.laurentMonomial y a ∈ S) → F ∈ S) ∧ V.valuation F < 1

Singularity.MonomialValuation.exists_val.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {V : ValuationSubring K} [inst_4 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {x : ι → K},
  Singularity.IsMonomialValuation k V x →
    ∀ {z : K}, z ≠ 0 → ∃ a, V.valuation z = V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a)

Singularity.MonomialValuation.hasRegular.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {k : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Field k]
  [inst_3 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K} [inst_4 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K]
  [inst_6 : DecidableEq ι] {x : ι → K},
  Singularity.IsMonomialValuation k V x →
    ∀ {B C : Matrix ι ι ℤ},
      B * C = 1 →
        C * B = 1 →
          (∀ (l : ι), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x (B l)) < 1) →
            ∀ (s : Finset K),
              (∀ z ∈ s, z ∈ V) →
                (∀ z ∈ s,
                    ∃ f g,
                      f ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range fun l => Singularity.laurentMonomial x (B l)) ∧
                        g ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range fun l => Singularity.laurentMonomial x (B l)) ∧
                          V.valuation g = 1 ∧ z * g = f) →
                  Singularity.HasRegularCenter k V ↑s

Singularity.OriginRuns.cleanOrdAlong_eq_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {p : ℕ} [CharP k p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    ∀ {S : Finset σ} {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
      Singularity.IsClean p F →
        ∀ {b : σ →₀ ℕ},
          b ∈ F.support →
            (∀ d ∈ F.support, ∑ i ∈ S, b i ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, d i) → Singularity.cleanOrdAlong p S F = ↑(∑ i ∈ S, b i)

Singularity.OriginRuns.cleanOrdAlong_exP.type:

  Singularity.IsClean p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) →
    Singularity.cleanOrdAlong p S (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
      ↑(min (∑ i ∈ S, (v + Finsupp.single 3 p) i)
          (∑ i ∈ S, (v + Singularity.OriginRuns.exOnes + Finsupp.single 3 (p - 2)) i))

Singularity.OriginRuns.coeff_originTrans.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] (p : ℕ) (j : σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k)
  (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g).coeff d =
    ∑ e ∈ g.support, if Singularity.OriginRuns.expStep p j e = d then g.coeff e else 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst : Field k] {p : ℕ} (j : σ) {g : MvPolynomial σ k},

Singularity.OriginRuns.cornerIneq_of.type:

Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor_hr.type: ∀ {v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ}, v 3 = 0 → ∀ i ∉ Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor, v i = 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.exG_eq.type:

          (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.OriginRuns.exOnes + Finsupp.single 3 (p - 2))) (c + 1)

Singularity.OriginRuns.example_3_14_9.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {l : List (Fin 4)},
  (∀ j ∈ l, j ≠ 3) →
    have v := Singularity.OriginRuns.exSteps l (Finsupp.single 0 1);
    Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p (Finsupp.single 0 1)) =
        Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v ∧
      Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p (Finsupp.single 0 1)) ∧
        Singularity.IsClean p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) ∧
          Singularity.logJacobianOrder Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) = ↑p ∧
            Singularity.ord
                  (Singularity.residualFactor Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v)) =
                ↑p ∧
              (∀ (t : Fin 4),
                  t ≠ 3 →
                    Singularity.orderGAlong p Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor (Finset.univ.erase t)
                        (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
                      ↑p) ∧
                (∀ (s : Fin 4),
                    s ≠ 3 →
                      Singularity.orderGAlong p Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor {3, s}
                            (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
                          ↑(p - 1) ∧
                        ↑(p - 1) <
                          Singularity.logJacobianOrder Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor
                            (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v)) ∧
                  Singularity.orderGAlong p Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor {3} (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
                      ↑(p - 2) ∧
                    ∀ (j : Fin 4),
                      j ≠ 3 →
                        Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor, Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v)
                          (Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor,
                            Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exStep j v))
