Singularity.cast_choose_pow_mul_eq_zero.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {e m₀ n : ℕ}, ¬p ^ e ∣ n → ↑((p ^ e * m₀).choose n) = 0

Singularity.cast_choose_pow_mul_pow.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] (e m₀ : ℕ), ↑((p ^ e * m₀).choose (p ^ e)) = ↑m₀

Singularity.centerChart.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.centerChartUnit.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → Finset σ → σ → (σ → k) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.centerChart_X_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (i : σ),
      (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) =
        (MvPolynomial.X j ^ if i ∈ S then 1 else 0) * (Singularity.centerRest S j t) (MvPolynomial.X i)

Singularity.centerChart_X_mul_pderiv_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (Δ : Finset σ)
  {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k) {m : σ},
      m ∈ S →
        (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) ∈
          Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) g)

Singularity.centerChart_X_mul_pderiv_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {m j : σ},
  m ∈ S →
    m ≠ j →
      ∀ (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
        (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) =
          (MvPolynomial.X m + MvPolynomial.C (t m)) * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {m j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    m ∉ S →
      ∀ (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
        (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) =
          MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) g)

Singularity.centerChart_X_of_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i j : σ} (t : σ → k),
  i ∈ S →
    i ≠ j →
      (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (t i))

Singularity.centerChart_X_of_notMem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i j : σ} (t : σ → k),
  i ∉ S → i ≠ j → (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X i

Singularity.centerChart_X_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X j) = MvPolynomial.X j

Singularity.centerChart_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
      (Singularity.centerChart S j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) =
        (MvPolynomial.X j ^ ∑ i ∈ S, a i) * (Singularity.centerRest S j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c)

Singularity.centerChart_monomial_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {S : Finset σ}
  {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (r : σ →₀ ℕ),
      (Singularity.centerChart S j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1) =
        (MvPolynomial.X j ^ ∑ i ∈ S, r i) * (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.centerExponent S j t r)) 1 *
          Singularity.centerChartUnit S j t r

Singularity.centerChart_univ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Fintype σ] (j : σ)
  (t : σ → k), Singularity.centerChart Finset.univ j t = Singularity.pointChart j t

Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal_mono.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {m n : ℕ},
  m ≤ n → Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S n ≤ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S m

Singularity.centerDivisor.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → Finset σ → Finset σ → σ → (σ → k) → Finset σ

Singularity.centerDivisor_univ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k]
  [inst_3 : Fintype σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Singularity.centerDivisor Δ Finset.univ j t = Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t

Singularity.centerExample_H1.type:
∀ f ∈ Singularity.logJacobian {2} (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3),
  ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑{0, 1}) ^ 2,
    f =
      (MvPolynomial.monomial
            (Singularity.divisorExponent {2} (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3)))
          1 *
        q

Singularity.centerExample_centerChart.type:
(Singularity.centerChart {0, 1} 0 0) (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3) =
  MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 2 * (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3)

Singularity.centerExample_cpOmega_lt.type:
Singularity.cpOmega {2} (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3) <
  Singularity.cpOmega (Singularity.centerDivisor {2} {0, 1} 0 0)
    (Singularity.cleanPart 2 (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3))

Singularity.centerExample_hyp.type:
MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3 ≠ 0 ∧
  Singularity.IsClean 2 (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3) ∧
    MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3 ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑{0, 1}) ^ 2

Singularity.centerExample_not_H2.type:
¬((∀ f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianCenter {2} {0, 1} (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3),
      ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑{0, 1}) ^ (2 + 1),
        f =
          (MvPolynomial.monomial
                (Singularity.divisorExponent {2} (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3)))
              1 *
            q) ∨
    ∃ q,
      (MvPolynomial.monomial
                (Singularity.divisorExponent {2} (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3)))
              1 *
            q ∈
          Singularity.logJacobianCenter {2} {0, 1} (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3) ∧
        Singularity.ord q = ↑2)

Singularity.centerExponent.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → Finset σ → σ → (σ → k) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → σ →₀ ℕ

Singularity.centerExponent.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {inst_2 : DecidableEq k}
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq k] (S S_1 : Finset σ),
  S = S_1 →
    ∀ (j j_1 : σ),
      j = j_1 →
        ∀ (t t_1 : σ → k),
          t = t_1 →
            ∀ (r r_1 : σ →₀ ℕ),
              r = r_1 → Singularity.centerExponent S j t r = Singularity.centerExponent S_1 j_1 t_1 r_1

Singularity.centerIdeal.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → (V : ValuationSubring K) → (A : Subring K) → A ≤ V.toSubring → Ideal ↥A

Singularity.centerLocalization.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → ValuationSubring K → Subring K → Set K

Singularity.centerLocalization_eq_of_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) {A A' : Subring K},
  A ≤ A' →
    (∀ x ∈ A', x ∈ Singularity.centerLocalization V A) →
      Singularity.centerLocalization V A' = Singularity.centerLocalization V A

Singularity.centerRest.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.centerRest_monomial_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (S : Finset σ)
  (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (r : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.centerRest S j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1) =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.centerExponent S j t r)) 1 * Singularity.centerChartUnit S j t r

Singularity.centerSubring.type: {K : Type u_2} → [inst : Field K] → ValuationSubring K → Subring K → Subring K

Singularity.centerSubring_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {R S : Subring K},
  S ≤ Singularity.centerSubring V R → Singularity.centerSubring V S ≤ Singularity.centerSubring V R

Singularity.centerSubring_le_toSubring.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {R : Subring K},
  R ≤ V.toSubring → Singularity.centerSubring V R ≤ V.toSubring

Singularity.centerSubring_map.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} {K' : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field K'] (e : K ≃+* K') (V' : ValuationSubring K')
  (R : Subring K),
  Singularity.centerSubring V' (Subring.map e.toRingHom R) =
    Subring.map e.toRingHom (Singularity.centerSubring (V'.comap e.toRingHom) R)

Singularity.centerSubring_mono.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {R S : Subring K},
  R ≤ S → Singularity.centerSubring V R ≤ Singularity.centerSubring V S

Singularity.centerUnit.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → Finset σ → Finset σ → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.centerUnit_univ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k]
  [inst_3 : Fintype σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Singularity.centerUnit Δ Finset.univ j t = Singularity.blowupUnit Δ j t

Singularity.charPolyhedron.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → Set (σ → ℝ)

Singularity.charPolyhedron_X_pow_add_C_e.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [Nontrivial k] (e : ℕ) {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C ↑F) = (↑(p ^ e))⁻¹ • Singularity.newtonPolyhedron F

Singularity.charPolyhedron_X_pow_add_C_o.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [Nontrivial k] (e : ℕ)
  {F : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  (∀ (α : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) F ≠ 0 → ¬∀ (i : σ), p ^ e ∣ α i) →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C F) =
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C F)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  {F : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  (∀ (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) (α : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) F ≠ 0 → (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) (φ ^ p + F) ≠ 0) →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C F) =
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C F)

Singularity.charPolyhedron_add_orthant.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.charPolyhedron f + Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.charPolyhedron f

Singularity.charPolyhedron_example_3_1_7.type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [CharP k 2] [Nontrivial k],
  Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.X 0 ^ 2 + MvPowerSeries.X 1 ^ 3)) =
    2⁻¹ • Singularity.newtonPolyhedron (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3)

∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [CharP k 2] [Nontrivial k],
  Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.X 0 ^ 2 + MvPowerSeries.X 1 ^ 3)) =
    {2⁻¹ • Singularity.expToReal (Finsupp.single 1 3)} + Singularity.orthant (Fin 2)

Singularity.charPolyhedron_imperfect.type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] {t : k},
  (∀ (c : k), c ^ p ≠ t) →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C (Singularity.imperfectF p t)) =
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C (Singularity.imperfectF p t))

Singularity.charPolyhedron_subset_projPo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.charPolyhedron f ⊆ Singularity.projPolyhedron f

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) {φ : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff φ = 0 →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron f ⊆ Singularity.projPolyhedron ((Polynomial.taylor φ) f)

Singularity.charPolyhedron_taylor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) {ψ : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff ψ = 0 →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron ((Polynomial.taylor ψ) f) = Singularity.charPolyhedron f

Singularity.chartExponent.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → σ → (σ → k) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → σ →₀ ℕ

Singularity.chartExponent.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {inst_2 : DecidableEq k}
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq k] (j j_1 : σ),
  j = j_1 →
    ∀ (t t_1 : σ → k),
      t = t_1 → ∀ (r r_1 : σ →₀ ℕ), r = r_1 → Singularity.chartExponent j t r = Singularity.chartExponent j_1 t_1 r_1

Singularity.chartLinear.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartLinear_eq_chartRest.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {m : ℕ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g.IsHomogeneous m →
    ((Singularity.chartRest j t) g).IsHomogeneous m → (Singularity.chartLinear j t) g = (Singularity.chartRest j t) g

Singularity.chartN_eq_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
    ∀ (c : ℕ) {i : σ},
      i ∉ Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t → (Finsupp.single j c + Singularity.chartExponent j t r) i = 0

Singularity.chartRest.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartRest_monomial_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (r : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1) =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t r)) 1 * Singularity.chartUnit j t r

Singularity.chartRest_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ),
  Singularity.chartRest j 0 = Singularity.dehomogenize j

Singularity.chartShift.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartShift_comp_dehomogenize.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.chartShift j t).comp (Singularity.dehomogenize j) = Singularity.chartRest j t

Singularity.chartShift_injective.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Function.Injective ⇑(Singularity.chartShift j t)

Singularity.chartShift_neg_comp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.chartShift j (-t)).comp (Singularity.chartShift j t) = AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.chartTransform.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartUnit.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → σ → (σ → k) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartUnit_mul_chartTransform.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                Singularity.idealOrd
                      (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree
                          (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                        d) →
                  ∀ {ψ f' : MvPolynomial σ k},
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑d →
                      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈
                          Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                        (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ) =
                            MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * f' →
                          f' ∈
                              Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                (Singularity.cleanPart p g') →
                            Singularity.ord (Singularity.chartTransform j t d ψ) = ↑d ∧
                              Singularity.chartUnit j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) *
                                  Singularity.chartTransform j t d ψ ∈
                                Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixSet (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                  (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] [inst_3 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixSet Δ g →
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑m ∧
                      Singularity.ord (Singularity.chartTransform j t m ψ) = ↑m ∧
                        Singularity.chartUnit j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) *
                            Singularity.chartTransform j t m ψ ∈
                          Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrixSet (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                            (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

Singularity.chartUnlinear.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.chartUnlinear_comp_rename_co.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  ((Singularity.chartUnlinear j t).comp (MvPolynomial.rename some)).comp (Singularity.chartLinear j t) =
    MvPolynomial.rename some

Singularity.chartUnlinear_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} (t : σ → k) {w : σ → k},
  w j = 0 →
    ((Singularity.chartUnlinear j t).comp (Singularity.translate w)).comp (Singularity.chartLinear j t) =
      Singularity.translate w

Singularity.chartUnshift.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field k] →
      [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.chartUnshift_comp_chartLinea.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (b : MvPolynomial (Option σ) k),
  (Singularity.chartUnshift j t b).comp (Singularity.chartLinear j t) =
    MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => MvPolynomial.X (some i) + MvPolynomial.C (Singularity.chartVector j t i) * b

Singularity.chartUnshift_comp_chartRest.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (b : MvPolynomial (Option σ) k),
  (Singularity.chartUnshift j t b).comp (Singularity.chartRest j t) =
    (Singularity.chartUnshift j t 0).comp (Singularity.chartRest j t)

Singularity.chartVector.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → σ → k

Singularity.chartVector.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {inst_1 : DecidableEq σ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (j j_1 : σ),
  j = j_1 →
    ∀ (t t_1 : σ → k),
      t = t_1 → ∀ (a a_1 : σ), a = a_1 → Singularity.chartVector j t a = Singularity.chartVector j_1 t_1 a_1

Singularity.chartVector_mem_directrix_in.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                  ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) ≠ 0 →
                    Singularity.chartVector j t ∈
                      Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g))

Singularity.chartVector_mem_directrix_of.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑m →
                      Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
              Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                  ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + m + 1) →
                ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g →
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑m →
                      Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ)

Singularity.chartVector_mem_directrix_pd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              ∀ {l : σ},
                l ∉ Δ →
                  (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ≠ 0 →
                    Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') =
                        ↑(d - 1) →
                      Singularity.chartVector j t ∈
                        Singularity.directrix
                          ((MvPolynomial.pderiv l)
                            ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)))

Singularity.chartVector_ne_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Singularity.chartVector j t ≠ 0

Singularity.choose_cast_eq_zero.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] {e a n : ℕ},
  p ^ e ∣ a → ¬p ^ e ∣ n → ↑(a.choose n) = 0

Singularity.choose_pow_mul_cast.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (v b n : ℕ),
  ↑((p ^ v * b).choose n) = if p ^ v ∣ n then ↑(b.choose (n / p ^ v)) else 0

Singularity.ciSup_add_ciSup_le_of_forall.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty κ] {f : ι → Cardinal.{u}} {g : κ → Cardinal.{u}},
  BddAbove (Set.range f) →
    BddAbove (Set.range g) → ∀ {c : Cardinal.{u}}, (∀ (i : ι) (j : κ), f i + g j ≤ c) → iSup f + iSup g ≤ c

Singularity.cleanOrdAlong.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.cleanOrdAlong.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {inst_1 : DecidableEq σ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (p p_1 : ℕ),
  p = p_1 →
    ∀ (S S_1 : Finset σ),
      S = S_1 →
        ∀ (g g_1 : MvPolynomial σ k), g = g_1 → Singularity.cleanOrdAlong p S g = Singularity.cleanOrdAlong p_1 S_1 g_1

Singularity.cleanPart.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.cleanPart_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) = Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F

Singularity.cleanPart_eq_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {q : ℕ} {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean q F → Singularity.cleanPart q F = F

Singularity.coe_adjoinRangeElem.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3} (z : ι → K)
  (i : ι), ↑(Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k z i) = z i

Singularity.coe_aeval_valuationSubring.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] (z : ↥vL.valuationSubring)
  (p : Polynomial ↥vK.valuationSubring),
  ↑((Polynomial.aeval z) p) = (Polynomial.aeval ↑z) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap (↥vK.valuationSubring) K) p)

Singularity.coe_weightedHomogeneousCompo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ↑((MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n) f) = (MvPowerSeries.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n) ↑f

Singularity.coeff_X_add_C_pow_pow_mul.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] (c : R) (e m₀ n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c) ^ (p ^ e * m₀)).coeff n =
    if p ^ e ∣ n then (c ^ p ^ e) ^ (m₀ - n / p ^ e) * ↑(m₀.choose (n / p ^ e)) else 0

Singularity.coeff_X_add_C_pow_pow_mul_eq.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] (c : R) {e m₀ n : ℕ},
  ¬p ^ e ∣ n → ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c) ^ (p ^ e * m₀)).coeff n = 0

Singularity.coeff_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (i : σ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G).coeff a = ↑(a i) * G.coeff a

Singularity.coeff_X_pow_add_sum.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) (n : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.X ^ m + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * Polynomial.X ^ i).coeff n =
    if n < m then a n else if n = m then 1 else 0

Singularity.coeff_add_apply.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f g : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (f + g).coeff d = f.coeff d + g.coeff d

Singularity.coeff_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.cleanPart q F).coeff d = if ∀ (i : σ), q ∣ d i then 0 else F.coeff d

Singularity.coeff_divisorExponent.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  g.coeff (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) = MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_ord.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  ↑(Finsupp.degree d) < Singularity.ord f → f.coeff d = 0

Singularity.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weighted.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < Singularity.weightedOrd w f → f.coeff d = 0

Singularity.coeff_imperfectF.type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (t : k) (α : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) (Singularity.imperfectF p t) =
    (if α = Finsupp.single 0 p then t else 0) + if α = Finsupp.single 1 (p + 1) then 1 else 0

Singularity.coeff_initialForm.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.initialForm w f).coeff d =
    if (Finsupp.weight w) d = (Singularity.weightedOrd w f).toNat then f.coeff d else 0

Singularity.coeff_iterate_divX.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (f : Polynomial K) (j n : ℕ), (Polynomial.divX^[j] f).coeff n = f.coeff (n + j)

Singularity.coeff_killOutside.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∈ a.support, i ∈ S) → ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ k), ((Singularity.killOutside S) f).coeff a = f.coeff a

Singularity.coeff_killVar_eq_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {i : σ} {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  a i ≠ 0 → ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ k), ((Singularity.killVar i) F).coeff a = 0

Singularity.coeff_pow_eq_zero_of_not_dvd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial σ k)
  {d : σ →₀ ℕ}, (¬∀ (i : σ), p ^ e ∣ d i) → (h ^ p ^ e).coeff d = 0

Singularity.coeff_pow_expChar_pow_eq_zer.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (¬∀ (i : σ), p ^ e ∣ d i) → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) (φ ^ p ^ e) = 0

Singularity.coeff_pred_X_add_C.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (a : ℕ → A) (d : A),
      ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ m +
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ i).coeff
          (m - 1) =
        a (m - 1) + ↑m * d

Singularity.coeff_pred_taylor_of_monic.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] {f : Polynomial A},
  f.Monic →
    1 ≤ f.natDegree →
      ∀ (d : A), ((Polynomial.taylor d) f).coeff (f.natDegree - 1) = f.coeff (f.natDegree - 1) + ↑f.natDegree * d

Singularity.coeff_pred_taylor_tschirnhau.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] {f : Polynomial A},
  f.Monic →
    1 ≤ f.natDegree →
      ∀ {u : A},
        ↑f.natDegree * u = 1 → ((Polynomial.taylor (-(f.coeff (f.natDegree - 1) * u))) f).coeff (f.natDegree - 1) = 0

Singularity.coeff_smul_add_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G).coeff a = ↑(r i + a i) * G.coeff a

Singularity.coeff_smul_pow_char.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) (α : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff (p • α)) (φ ^ p) = (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) φ ^ p

Singularity.coeff_sum_smul_add_X_mul_pde.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (∑ i, (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G)).coeff a =
    ↑(Finsupp.degree r + Finsupp.degree a) * G.coeff a

Singularity.coeff_taylor_X_pow_add_sum.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) (d : A),
  (Polynomial.taylor d) (Polynomial.X ^ m + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * Polynomial.X ^ i) =
    (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ m + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ i

Singularity.coeff_taylor_eq_sum.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring A] (f : Polynomial A) (h : A) (d : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor h) f).coeff d = ∑ e ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1), ↑(e.choose d) * f.coeff e * h ^ (e - d)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k)
  (d : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial β) c)) f).coeff d =
    ∑ e ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1),
      ↑(e.choose d) * f.coeff e * (MvPowerSeries.monomial ((e - d) • β)) (c ^ (e - d))

Singularity.coeff_taylor_natDegree_sub.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : Polynomial R) (c : R) {i : ℕ},
  i ≤ f.natDegree →
    ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (f.natDegree - i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), ↑((f.natDegree - j).choose (i - j)) * f.coeff (f.natDegree - j) * c ^ (i - j)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_natDegree_sub_e.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : Polynomial R) (c : R) {i : ℕ},
  0 < i →
    i ≤ f.natDegree →
      ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (f.natDegree - i) =
        f.coeff (f.natDegree - i) + ↑(f.natDegree.choose i) * f.coeff f.natDegree * c ^ i +
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 i, ↑((f.natDegree - j).choose (i - j)) * f.coeff (f.natDegree - j) * c ^ (i - j)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_natDegree_sub_o.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {f : Polynomial R},
  p ∣ f.natDegree → ∀ (c : R), ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (f.natDegree - 1) = f.coeff (f.natDegree - 1)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_sub_of_lt_pow.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {f : Polynomial R} {e m₀ m : ℕ},
  m = p ^ e * m₀ →
    f.natDegree = m →
      ∀ (c : R) {i : ℕ},
        0 < i →
          i < p ^ e →
            ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (m - i) =
              f.coeff (m - i) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 i, ↑((m - j).choose (i - j)) * f.coeff (m - j) * c ^ (i - j)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_sub_of_lt_pow_o.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {f : Polynomial R} {e m₀ m : ℕ},
  m = p ^ e * m₀ →
    f.natDegree = m →
      ∀ (c : R) {i : ℕ},
        0 < i →
          i < p ^ e →
            (∀ (j : ℕ), 0 < j → j < i → f.coeff (m - j) = 0) → ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (m - i) = f.coeff (m - i)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_sub_pow.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {f : Polynomial R},
  f.Monic →
    ∀ {e m₀ m : ℕ},
      m = p ^ e * m₀ →
        f.natDegree = m →
          ∀ (c : R),
            ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (m - p ^ e) =
              f.coeff (m - p ^ e) + ↑m₀ * c ^ p ^ e +
                ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 (p ^ e), ↑((m - j).choose (p ^ e - j)) * f.coeff (m - j) * c ^ (p ^ e - j)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_sub_pow_of_eq_z.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {f : Polynomial R},
  f.Monic →
    ∀ {e m₀ m : ℕ},
      m = p ^ e * m₀ →
        f.natDegree = m →
          ∀ (c : R),
            (∀ (j : ℕ), 0 < j → j < p ^ e → f.coeff (m - j) = 0) →
              ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (m - p ^ e) = f.coeff (m - p ^ e) + ↑m₀ * c ^ p ^ e

Singularity.coeff_top_X_add_C.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) (d : A),
  ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ m +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ i).coeff
      m =
    1

Singularity.coeff_vertexPoly.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (v : σ →₀ ℕ) (d : ℕ),
  (Singularity.vertexPoly f v).coeff d =
    if d ≤ f.natDegree then (MvPowerSeries.coeff ((f.natDegree - d) • v)) (f.coeff d) else 0

Singularity.coeff_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) (e : Option σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.zMonic m a).coeff e =
    if e none < m then (a (e none)).coeff e.some else if e none = m then (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff 1) e.some else 0

Singularity.comap_pointwise_smul.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (σ : Gal(L/K))
  (W : ValuationSubring L), (σ • W).comap (algebraMap K L) = W.comap (algebraMap K L)

Singularity.comap_purelyInseparableExten.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ)
  [inst_3 : ExpChar K p] [inst_4 : IsPurelyInseparable K L] (V : ValuationSubring K),
  (Singularity.purelyInseparableExtension p V).comap (algebraMap K L) = V

Singularity.comap_valuationSubring_eq_of.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {K₀ : IntermediateField k K}
  {Γ₀ : Type u_3} {Γ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] (v₀ : Valuation (↥K₀) Γ₀) (v : Valuation K Γ) [v₀.HasExtension v],
  v.valuationSubring.comap (algebraMap (↥K₀) K) = v₀.valuationSubring

Singularity.comap_valuation_eq_one_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {L : Type u_5} [inst_1 : Field L] (f : L →+* K) (c : L),
  (V.comap f).valuation c = 1 ↔ V.valuation (f c) = 1

Singularity.completeFamily.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type uV} →
      [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] →
        {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} →
          {φ : Polynomial K} →
            (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w f) →
              φ.Monic →
                ν φ < w φ →
                  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = w f) →
                    Singularity.ContinuousFamily w (↑(Singularity.completeValues ν φ))ᵒᵈ

Singularity.completeFamily_isStable.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {hle : ∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w f} {hm : φ.Monic}
  {hlt : ν φ < w φ} {hlow : ∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = w f} {ψ : Polynomial K},
  ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → (Singularity.completeFamily hle hm hlt hlow).IsStable ψ

Singularity.completeFamily_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {hle : ∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w f} {hm : φ.Monic}
  {hlt : ν φ < w φ} {hlow : ∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = w f},
  (∀ (i : (↑(Singularity.completeValues ν φ))ᵒᵈ) (f : Polynomial K),
      ν f ≤
        Singularity.augmentedValuationFun w ((Singularity.completeFamily hle hm hlt hlow).key i)
          ((Singularity.completeFamily hle hm hlt hlow).value i) f) ∧
    ∀ (i : (↑(Singularity.completeValues ν φ))ᵒᵈ) (a : Polynomial K),
      a.degree < ((Singularity.completeFamily hle hm hlt hlow).key i).degree → ν a = w a

Singularity.completeKey.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type uV} →
      [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] →
        {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} → {φ : Polynomial K} → (↑(Singularity.completeValues ν φ))ᵒᵈ → Polynomial K

Singularity.completeKey_spec.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} (i : (↑(Singularity.completeValues ν φ))ᵒᵈ),
  (Singularity.completeKey i).Monic ∧
    (Singularity.completeKey i).natDegree = φ.natDegree ∧ ν (Singularity.completeKey i) = ↑(OrderDual.ofDual i)

Singularity.completeValues.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type uV} → [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] → Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀ → Polynomial K → Set Γ₀

Singularity.completeValues_noMaxOrder.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (ψ₀ : Polynomial K),
      ψ₀.Monic → ψ₀.natDegree = φ.natDegree → ∃ ψ, ψ.Monic ∧ ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree ∧ ν ψ < ν ψ₀) →
    NoMaxOrder (↑(Singularity.completeValues ν φ))ᵒᵈ

Singularity.completeValues_nonempty.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K}, φ.Monic → Nonempty (↑(Singularity.completeValues ν φ))ᵒᵈ

Singularity.completeValues_spec.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} (i : (↑(Singularity.completeValues ν φ))ᵒᵈ),
  ∃ ψ, ψ.Monic ∧ ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree ∧ ν ψ = ↑(OrderDual.ofDual i)

Singularity.coneLemma.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : LinearOrder V] [IsOrderedAddMonoid V] [inst_3 : Module ℚ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℚ V] (E : Finset V),
  (∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ e) →
    ∃ m, (∀ (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℚ V)), 0 < m i) ∧ ∀ e ∈ E, ∀ (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℚ V)), 0 ≤ (m.repr e) i

Singularity.constantCoeff_blowupUnit_ne_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (Δ : Finset σ)
  (j : σ) (t : σ → k), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.blowupUnit Δ j t) ≠ 0

Singularity.constantCoeff_centerChartUni.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (S : Finset σ)
  (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (r : σ →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.centerChartUnit S j t r) ≠ 0

Singularity.constantCoeff_centerUnit_ne_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (Δ S : Finset σ)
  (j : σ) (t : σ → k), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.centerUnit Δ S j t) ≠ 0

Singularity.constantCoeff_chartUnit_ne_z.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (r : σ →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.chartUnit j t r) ≠ 0

Singularity.constantCoeff_linearChange_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (A : Matrix σ σ R) (i : σ),
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((Singularity.linearChange A) (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0

Singularity.constantCoeff_monomial_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
  v ≠ 0 → ∀ (c : k), MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff ((MvPowerSeries.monomial v) c) = 0

Singularity.constantCoeff_smul_add_X_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G) =
    ↑(r i) * MvPolynomial.constantCoeff G

Singularity.convexHull_add_orthant_add_o.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} (S : Set (σ → ℝ)),
  (convexHull ℝ) S + Singularity.orthant σ + Singularity.orthant σ = (convexHull ℝ) S + Singularity.orthant σ

Singularity.convexHull_add_orthant_subse.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {S P : Set (σ → ℝ)},
  S ⊆ P → Convex ℝ P → P + Singularity.orthant σ ⊆ P → (convexHull ℝ) S + Singularity.orthant σ ⊆ P

Singularity.convexHull_orthant.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1}, (convexHull ℝ) (Singularity.orthant σ) = Singularity.orthant σ

Singularity.convexHull_union_add_orthant.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {P Q : Set (σ → ℝ)},
  P + Singularity.orthant σ = P →
    Q + Singularity.orthant σ = Q → (convexHull ℝ) (P ∪ Q) + Singularity.orthant σ = (convexHull ℝ) (P ∪ Q)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),

Singularity.convex_newtonPolyhedron.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),

Singularity.convex_projPolyhedron.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),

Singularity.cpOmega.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.cpOmega_cleanPart_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          Singularity.cpOmega (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤ Singularity.cpOmega Δ g

Singularity.cpOmega_cleanPart_le_center.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p]
  {Δ S : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    j ∈ S →
      g ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ p →
        (Singularity.centerChart S j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {ρ : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑ρ →
              (∀ f ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g,
                  ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ ρ,
                    f = (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * q) →
                ((∀ f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g,
                      ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ (ρ + 1),
                        f = (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * q) ∨
                    ∃ q,
                      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * q ∈
                          Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g ∧
                        Singularity.ord q = ↑ρ) →
                  Singularity.cpOmega (Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                    Singularity.cpOmega Δ g

Singularity.cpOmega_eq_logJacobianOrder.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 → Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.cpOmega Δ g = Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g

Singularity.cpOmega_of_exists.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∃ j ∉ Δ, (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (Singularity.ord g).toNat) g) ≠ 0) →
    Singularity.cpOmega Δ g = Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) - 1

Singularity.cpOmega_of_forall.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ j ∉ Δ, (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (Singularity.ord g).toNat) g) = 0) →
    Singularity.cpOmega Δ g = Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.cuspPair.type: {R : Type u_1} → [CommRing R] → R → R → R

Singularity.cuspPair_chart_one.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ : R),
  ((x * y₁) ^ 2 - x ^ 3) * ((x * y₁) ^ 2 - x ^ 5) = x ^ 4 * (y₁ ^ 2 - x) * (y₁ ^ 2 - x ^ 3)

Singularity.cuspPair_chart_three.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y₂ x₃ : R), y₂ ^ 2 - y₂ * x₃ = y₂ * (y₂ - x₃)

Singularity.cuspPair_chart_two_x.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y₁ x₂ : R),
  (y₁ ^ 2 - y₁ * x₂) * (y₁ ^ 2 - (y₁ * x₂) ^ 3) = y₁ ^ 3 * (y₁ - x₂) * (1 - y₁ * x₂ ^ 3)

Singularity.cuspPair_chart_two_y.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₂ : R),
  ((x * y₂) ^ 2 - x) * ((x * y₂) ^ 2 - x ^ 3) = x ^ 3 * (x * y₂ ^ 2 - 1) * (y₂ ^ 2 - x)

Singularity.cuspPair_inter.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {x y : R},
  y ^ 2 = x ^ 3 → y ^ 2 = x ^ 5 → 1 - x ^ 2 ≠ 0 → x = 0 ∧ y = 0

Singularity.cuspPair_order_five.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x₃ w : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair (x₃ ^ 2 * w) (x₃ ^ 5 * w ^ 3) = x₃ ^ 16 * w ^ 8 * ((w ^ 3 * x₃ ^ 4 - 1) * (w - 1))

Singularity.cuspPair_order_four.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x₂ w : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair (x₂ ^ 2 * w) (x₂ ^ 3 * w ^ 2) = x₂ ^ 12 * w ^ 7 * ((w - 1) * (1 - w * x₂ ^ 4))

Singularity.cuspPair_order_one.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair x (x * y₁) = x ^ 4 * ((y₁ ^ 2 - x) * (y₁ ^ 2 - x ^ 3))

Singularity.cuspPair_order_three.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y₂ x₃ : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair (y₂ * x₃) (y₂ ^ 3 * x₃ ^ 2) = y₂ ^ 8 * x₃ ^ 7 * ((y₂ ^ 3 * x₃ - 1) * (y₂ - x₃))

Singularity.cuspPair_order_two.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y₁ x₂ : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair (y₁ * x₂) (y₁ ^ 2 * x₂) = y₁ ^ 7 * x₂ ^ 4 * ((y₁ - x₂) * (1 - y₁ * x₂ ^ 3))

Singularity.degree_eq_add_degree_erase.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (j : σ) (c : σ →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree c = c j + Finsupp.degree (Finsupp.erase j c)

Singularity.degree_eq_none_add_degree_so.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (e : Option σ →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree e = e none + Finsupp.degree e.some

Singularity.degree_expansionCoeff_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → ∀ (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ), (Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j).degree < φ.degree

Singularity.degree_mono.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {N r : σ →₀ ℕ}, N ≤ r → Finsupp.degree N ≤ Finsupp.degree r

Singularity.degree_mul_divByMonic_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ a b : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → 0 < φ.natDegree → a.degree < φ.degree → b.degree < φ.degree → (a * b /ₘ φ).degree < φ.degree

Singularity.degree_sub_lt_of_monic.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → (ψ - φ).degree < φ.degree

Singularity.degree_sum_lt_degree.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {α : Type u_4} {s : Finset α} {G : α → Polynomial K},
      (∀ x ∈ s, (G x).degree < φ.degree) → (∑ x ∈ s, G x).degree < φ.degree

Singularity.dehomogenize.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.dehomogenize_comp_chartRest.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.dehomogenize j).comp (Singularity.chartRest j t) = Singularity.chartRest j t

Singularity.dehomogenize_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.dehomogenize j) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) = (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.erase j a)) c

Singularity.derivIdeal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R) → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.derivIdeal_le_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {n : ℕ},
  I ≤ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n → Singularity.derivIdeal I ≤ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ (n - 1)

Singularity.derivIdeal_mono.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  I ≤ J → Singularity.derivIdeal I ≤ Singularity.derivIdeal J

Singularity.derivIdeal_span.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (S : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.derivIdeal (Ideal.span S) = Ideal.span (S ∪ {g | ∃ i, ∃ f ∈ S, g = (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f})

Singularity.derivation_mem_pow_pred.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra R B]
  (D : Derivation R B B) (I : Ideal B) (e : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ I ^ e, D x ∈ I ^ (e - 1)

Singularity.derivation_mem_pow_succ.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra R B]
  (D : Derivation R B B) (I : Ideal B) (e : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ I ^ (e + 1), D x ∈ I ^ e

Singularity.derivative_one_add_X_pow_suc.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [CharP R p],
  Polynomial.derivative (1 + Polynomial.X ^ (p + 1)) = Polynomial.X ^ p

Singularity.directrix.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → MvPolynomial σ k → Submodule k (σ → k)

Singularity.directrixPolys.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → (σ → k) → Submodule k (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.directrix_homogeneousCompone.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {m : ℕ} {u ψ' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff u ≠ 0 →
    ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord ψ' →
      Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) (u * ψ')) =
        Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ')

Singularity.directrix_le_directrix_smul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (c : k) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.directrix F ≤ Singularity.directrix (c • F)

Singularity.directrix_smul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {c : k},
  c ≠ 0 → ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.directrix (c • F) = Singularity.directrix F

Singularity.directrix_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k], Singularity.directrix 0 = ⊤

Singularity.divByMonic_X_eq_divX.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (f : Polynomial K), f /ₘ Polynomial.X = f.divX

Singularity.divX_iterate_eq_zero.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (f : Polynomial R) {n : ℕ}, f.natDegree < n → Polynomial.divX^[n] f = 0

Singularity.divisorExponent.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → σ →₀ ℕ

Singularity.divisorExponent_apply.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k)
  (i : σ), (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) i = if i ∈ Δ then sInf ((fun d => d i) '' ↑F.support) else 0

Singularity.divisorExponent_eq_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {i : σ},
  i ∉ Δ → (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ P) i = 0

Singularity.divisorExponent_eq_zero_of.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ i ∈ Δ, ∃ β ∈ P.support, β i = 0) → Singularity.divisorExponent Δ P = 0

Singularity.divisorExponent_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {β : σ →₀ ℕ},
  β ∈ P.support → Singularity.divisorExponent Δ P ≤ β

Singularity.dvd_apply_of_dvd_degree.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {q : ℕ} {α : σ →₀ ℕ} (j : σ),
  (∀ (i : σ), i ≠ j → q ∣ α i) → q ∣ Finsupp.degree α → ∀ (i : σ), q ∣ α i

Singularity.dvd_pointChart_of_monomial_o.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : ℕ} {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 ∣ h →
    ↑(Finsupp.degree r + c) ≤ Singularity.ord h →
      MvPolynomial.X j ^ (Finsupp.degree r + c) * (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t r)) 1 ∣
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) h

Singularity.eq_centerIdeal_of_ofPrime_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {P : Ideal ↥A} [inst_1 : P.IsPrime]
  (h : LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring), P = Singularity.centerIdeal V A ⋯

Singularity.eq_inv_smul_sum_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {w : σ → ℕ} {D : ℕ} {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w h D →
    ↑D ≠ 0 → h = (↑D)⁻¹ • ∑ i, ↑(w i) • (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.eq_of_isMuMinimal.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w f) →
    ∀ {φ : Polynomial K},
      φ.Monic →
        0 < φ.natDegree →
          Singularity.IsMuMinimal ν φ → (∀ (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < φ.degree → w a = ν a) → w φ = ν φ → w = ν

Singularity.eq_of_map_eq_zero_of_degree_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {D : WithBot ℕ},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < D → w f = ν f) → ∀ {a : Polynomial K}, a ≠ 0 → a.degree < D → ν a = 0 → w = ν

Singularity.eq_of_ofPrime_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {P Q : Ideal ↥A} [inst_1 : P.IsPrime]
  [inst_2 : Q.IsPrime],
  LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring → LocalSubring.ofPrime A Q ≤ V.toLocalSubring → P = Q

Singularity.eq_of_specializes_of_isDiscr.type: ∀ {T : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace T] {s : Set T}, IsDiscrete s → ∀ {x y : T}, x ∈ s → y ∈ s → x ⤳ y → x = y

Singularity.eq_purelyInseparableExtensio.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ)
  [inst_3 : ExpChar K p] [inst_4 : IsPurelyInseparable K L] (V : ValuationSubring K) (W : ValuationSubring L),
  W.comap (algebraMap K L) = V → W = Singularity.purelyInseparableExtension p V

Singularity.eq_sum_expansionCoeff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      ∀ (f : Polynomial K), f = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j * φ ^ j

Singularity.eq_sum_expansionCoeff_add.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f : Polynomial K) (N : ℕ),
  f = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j * φ ^ j + φ ^ N * (fun g => g /ₘ φ)^[N] f

Singularity.eq_sum_smul_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : CommSemiring k] (w : σ → k) {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ a ∈ h.support, ∑ i ∈ a.support, w i * ↑(a i) = 1) → h = ∑ i, w i • (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.eq_zero_of_directrix_eq_top.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff F = 0 → Singularity.directrix F = ⊤ → F = 0

Singularity.eq_zero_of_le_ord_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ},
  IsUnit ↑m →
    ∀ {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
      a (m - 1) = 0 →
        ∀ (b : Option σ → R),
          ↑m ≤
              Singularity.ord
                ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C (b o)) (Singularity.zMonic m a)) →
            b none = 0

Singularity.essFiniteType_of_trdeg_le_tr.type:
∀ {k K : Type u} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K],
  Singularity.IsFunctionField k K →
    ∀ (V : ValuationSubring K) [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K],
      Algebra.trdeg k K ≤ Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V) + 1 → Algebra.EssFiniteType k ↥V

Singularity.eulerTotal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.eulerVar.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.eulerVar_X_pow_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  (j : σ) {e n : ℕ},
  n < p ^ e →
    ∀ (P : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (Singularity.eulerVar j n) (MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * P) =
        MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * (Singularity.eulerVar j n) P

Singularity.eulerVar_pointChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (n : ℕ)
  (P : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.eulerVar j n) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) P) =
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((Singularity.eulerTotal n) P)

Singularity.eval_artinSchreierPoly.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (p : ℕ) (a x : R),
  Polynomial.eval x (Singularity.artinSchreierPoly p a) = x ^ p - x - a

Singularity.eval_eq_zero_of_eq_sum.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : CommSemiring k] (w : σ → k) {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  h = ∑ i, w i • (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h) →
    ∀ {v : σ → k},
      (∀ (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.eval v) (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h) = 0) →
        (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0

Singularity.eval_eq_zero_of_isCriticalPo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : CommSemiring k] (w : σ → k) {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  h = ∑ i, w i • (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h) →
    ∀ {v : σ → k}, Singularity.IsCriticalPoint h v → (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : Field k] {w : σ → ℕ} {D : ℕ} {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w h D →
    ↑D ≠ 0 → ∀ {v : σ → k}, Singularity.IsCriticalPoint h v → (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] [Fintype σ] {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  ¬Singularity.IsResonant p h.support → ∀ {v : σ → k}, Singularity.IsCriticalPoint h v → (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0

Singularity.eval_eq_zero_of_mem_pointIde.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {x : ι → R} {f : MvPolynomial ι R},
  f ∈ Singularity.pointIdeal x → (MvPolynomial.eval x) f = 0

Singularity.eval_purelyInseparable.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial σ k) (z : k) (v : σ → k),
  (MvPolynomial.eval fun o => o.elim z v) (Singularity.purelyInseparable q h) = z ^ q + (MvPolynomial.eval v) h

Singularity.eventually_eq_of_succ_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
    ∀ {μ : ℕ → Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ (μ n) f) →
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial K), (μ (n + 1)) f ≤ (μ n) f) →
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial K), ν f < (μ n) f → (μ (n + 1)) f < (μ n) f) →
            (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial K), (μ n) f ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) →
              ∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≠ 0 → ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → (μ n) f = ν f

Singularity.eventually_le_of_succ_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
    ∀ {μ : ℕ → Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial K), (μ (n + 1)) f ≤ (μ n) f) →
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial K), ν f < (μ n) f → (μ (n + 1)) f < (μ n) f) →
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial K), (μ n) f ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) →
            ∀ (f : Polynomial K) {c : Γ₀}, c ≠ 0 → ν f ≤ c → ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → (μ n) f ≤ c

Singularity.example_3_1_11.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  (∀ (c : RatFunc (ZMod p)),
      ¬Singularity.IsSolvableVertex (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C (Singularity.imperfectF p RatFunc.X))
          (Finsupp.single 0 1) c) ∧
    Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C (Singularity.imperfectF p RatFunc.X)) =
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C (Singularity.imperfectF p RatFunc.X))

Singularity.existsUnique_valuationSubrin.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p]
  [IsPurelyInseparable K L] (V : ValuationSubring K), ∃! W, W.comap (algebraMap K L) = V

Singularity.exists_add_pow_eq_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [PerfectRing k p] (e : ℕ)
  (F : MvPolynomial σ k), ∃ h, F + h ^ p ^ e = Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F

Singularity.exists_algebraMap_eq_trace.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
  [inst_3 : Field K] [inst_4 : Field L] [inst_5 : Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] [inst_7 : Algebra K L]
  [inst_8 : Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] {b : L},
