Singularity.exists_pointChart_X_eq_X_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (m : σ),
  ∃ c, (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X m) = MvPolynomial.X j * c

Singularity.exists_pointChart_eq_X_pow_m.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {m : ℕ}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ k}, ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f → ∃ f', (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f'

Singularity.exists_pow_mem_range.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p]
  [IsPurelyInseparable K L] (b : L), ∃ n y, (algebraMap K L) y = b ^ p ^ n

Singularity.exists_purelyInseparable_tow.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ)
  [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP K p] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsPurelyInseparable K L] (V : ValuationSubring K),
  ∃ W,
    W.comap (algebraMap K L) = V ∧
      (∀ (W' : ValuationSubring L), W'.comap (algebraMap K L) = V → W' = W) ∧
        ∃ r E θ,
          E 0 = ⊥ ∧
            E r = ⊤ ∧
              Module.finrank K L = p ^ r ∧
                ∀ i < r,
                  E (i + 1) = E i ⊔ K⟮θ i⟯ ∧ θ i ∉ E i ∧ θ i ^ p ∈ E i ∧ (E i).relfinrank (E (i + 1)) = p ∧ θ i ∈ W

∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ)
  [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP K p] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsPurelyInseparable K L] (W : ValuationSubring L)
  (M : IntermediateField K L),
  ∃ r E θ, E 0 = M ∧ E r = ⊤ ∧ ∀ i < r, Singularity.IsInseparableStep p W (E i) (E (i + 1)) (θ i)

Singularity.exists_torus_isCriticalPoint.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [IsReduced k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  [PerfectRing k p] (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (∃ v, (∀ (i : σ), v i ≠ 0) ∧ Singularity.IsCriticalPoint h v) ↔
    (∃ v, (∀ (i : σ), v i ≠ 0) ∧ Singularity.IsSingularPoint h v) ∨
      ∃ u, (∀ (o : Option σ), u o ≠ 0) ∧ Singularity.IsSingularPoint (Singularity.purelyInseparable p h) u

Singularity.exists_torus_isSingularPoint.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [IsReduced k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  [PerfectRing k p] {w : σ → ℕ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {a : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : k},
  Singularity.initialForm w g = (MvPolynomial.monomial a) c →
    (∀ (i : σ), p ∣ a i) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∃ u,
          (∀ (o : Option σ), u o ≠ 0) ∧
            Singularity.IsSingularPoint (Singularity.purelyInseparable p (Singularity.initialForm w g)) u

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [IsReduced k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  [PerfectRing k p] {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ (i : σ), p ∣ a i) →
    ∀ {c : k},
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∃ u,
          (∀ (o : Option σ), u o ≠ 0) ∧
            Singularity.IsSingularPoint (Singularity.purelyInseparable p ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c)) u

Singularity.exists_valuationSubring_of_i.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (A : Subring K) (P : Ideal ↥A) [inst_1 : P.IsPrime],
  ∃ V, LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring ∧ A ≤ V.toSubring ∧ ∀ (a : ↥A), a ∈ P ↔ V.valuation ↑a < 1

Singularity.exists_valuation_aeval_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {κ : Type u_5}
  (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
  (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
      (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
    ∀ (P : MvPolynomial κ K), P ≠ 0 → ∃ c, vL ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun j => ↑(y j)) P) = vL ((algebraMap K L) ↑c)

Singularity.exists_valuation_aeval_eq_of.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] (z : ↥vL.valuationSubring)
  {p : Polynomial K},
  p ≠ 0 →
    p.natDegree <
        (minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
            ((IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) z)).natDegree →
      ∃ i,
        p.coeff i ≠ 0 ∧
          (∀ (j : ℕ), vK (p.coeff j) ≤ vK (p.coeff i)) ∧
            vL ((Polynomial.aeval ↑z) p) = vL ((algebraMap K L) (p.coeff i))

Singularity.exists_valuation_eq_laurentM.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {V : ValuationSubring K} {x : ι → K} {y : κ → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0) →
      (∀ c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun j => Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k (Sum.elim x y) (Sum.inr j)),
          c ∈ V.comap (algebraMap (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x y)))) K)) →
        ∀ {c : ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x y)))},
          c ≠ 0 → ∃ a, V.valuation ↑c = V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a)

Singularity.exists_zShift_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (h : MvPolynomial σ R) {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R),
      ∃ a', (Singularity.zShift h) (Singularity.zMonic m a) = Singularity.zMonic m a' ∧ a' (m - 1) = a (m - 1) + ↑m * h

Singularity.expToReal_apply.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ), Singularity.expToReal d i = ↑(d i)

Singularity.expToReal_mem_newtonPolyhedr.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  d ∈ f.support → Singularity.expToReal d ∈ Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f

Singularity.expansionCoeff.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → Polynomial K → Polynomial K → ℕ → Polynomial K

Singularity.expansionCoeff_X.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff Polynomial.X f j = Polynomial.C (f.coeff j)

Singularity.expansionCoeff_add.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f g : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (f + g) j = Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j + Singularity.expansionCoeff φ g j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_eq_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → 0 < φ.natDegree → ∀ {f : Polynomial K} {j : ℕ}, f.natDegree < j → Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j = 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_mul_left_succ.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ∀ (h : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ * h) (j + 1) = Singularity.expansionCoeff φ h j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_mul_left_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → ∀ (h : Polynomial K), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ * h) 0 = 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_neg.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (-f) j = -Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_pow_mul_add.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ∀ (h : Polynomial K) (n j : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ ^ n * h) (j + n) = Singularity.expansionCoeff φ h j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_pow_mul_of_de.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ∀ {c : Polynomial K},
      c.degree < φ.degree → ∀ (n k : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ ^ n * c) k = if k = n then c else 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_pow_mul_of_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → ∀ (h : Polynomial K) {n j : ℕ}, j < n → Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ ^ n * h) j = 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_succ.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f (j + 1) = Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (f /ₘ φ) j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_sum.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} {ι : Type u_3} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (∑ i ∈ s, F i) j = ∑ i ∈ s, Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (F i) j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_sum_mul_pow.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ∀ {c : ℕ → Polynomial K} {N : ℕ},
      (∀ j < N, (c j).degree < φ.degree) →
        ∀ (k : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, c j * φ ^ j) k = if k < N then c k else 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_zero.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (j : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ 0 j = 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_zero_eq_modBy.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f : Polynomial K), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f 0 = f %ₘ φ

Singularity.extremePoints_convexHull_add.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (S : Set (σ → ℝ)), Set.extremePoints ℝ ((convexHull ℝ) S + Singularity.orthant σ) ⊆ S

Singularity.extremePoints_projPolyhedron.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) ⊆ Singularity.projPoints f

Singularity.false_of_strictAnti.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
    ∀ {s : ℕ → Γ₀}, StrictAnti s → ∀ {c : Γ₀}, c ≠ 0 → (∀ (n : ℕ), c ≤ s n) → (∀ (n : ℕ), s n ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) → False

Singularity.false_of_strictAnti_of_noMax.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
    ∀ {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι] {s : ι → Γ₀},
      StrictAnti s → ∀ {c : Γ₀}, c ≠ 0 → (∀ (i : ι), c ≤ s i) → (∀ (i : ι), s i ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) → False

Singularity.finSepDegree_eq_card_algEqui.type:
∀ (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] [Normal F E],
  Field.finSepDegree F E = Nat.card Gal(E/F)

Singularity.finiteDimensional_adjoin_of_.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι],
  Singularity.IsFunctionField k K →
    ∀ {z : ι → K},
      AlgebraicIndependent k z →
        Algebra.trdeg k K ≤ ↑(Fintype.card ι) → FiniteDimensional (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range z))) K

Singularity.finiteDimensional_adjoin_sum.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K}
  [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K],
  Singularity.IsFunctionField k K →
    Singularity.IsAbhyankarValuation k V →
      ∀ {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4} [inst_5 : Fintype ι] [inst_6 : Fintype κ] {x : ι → K} {y : κ → ↥V},
        (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
          (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0) →
            (AlgebraicIndependent k fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y j)) →
              Module.rank ℚ (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ (Additive V.ValueGroupˣ)) = ↑(Fintype.card ι) →
                Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V) = ↑(Fintype.card κ) →
                  FiniteDimensional (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j))))) K

Singularity.finiteDimensional_residueFie.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {E' : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field E'] [inst_2 : Algebra E E'] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
  (v₀ : Valuation E Γ₀) (v : Valuation E' Γ) [inst_5 : v₀.HasExtension v] [FiniteDimensional E E'],
  FiniteDimensional (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥v₀.valuationSubring) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥v.valuationSubring) ∧
    Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥v₀.valuationSubring) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥v.valuationSubring) ≤
      Module.finrank E E'

∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] (V : ValuationSubring K)
  {E : IntermediateField k K} [FiniteDimensional (↥E) K] {F : Type u_3} [inst_4 : Field F]
  [inst_5 : Algebra F (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)],
  (∀ (c : ↥E) (hc : ↑c ∈ V), ∃ f, (algebraMap F (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)) f = (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) ⟨↑c, hc⟩) →
    FiniteDimensional F (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)

Singularity.finite_Icc_inter_range_int.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
  (c d : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite

Singularity.finite_quotient_of_valuation.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] (V : ValuationSubring K)
  {E : IntermediateField k K} [FiniteDimensional (↥E) K] (H : Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ),
  (∀ (c : ↥E) (hc : ↑c ≠ 0), Units.mk0 (V.valuation ↑c) ⋯ ∈ H) → Finite (V.ValueGroupˣ ⧸ H)

Singularity.finrank_iInf_directrix_le_of.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {m : ℕ}
  {u : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff u ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {S S' : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)},
      (∀ ψ ∈ S,
          Singularity.ord ψ = ↑m ∧
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.chartTransform j t m ψ) = ↑m ∧ u * Singularity.chartTransform j t m ψ ∈ S') →
        Module.finrank k ↥(⨅ ψ ∈ S', Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ)) ≤
          Module.finrank k ↥(⨅ ψ ∈ S, Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ))

Singularity.finrank_iInf_directrix_point.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] {ι : Type u_3} {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {m : ℕ} {ψ ψ' : ι → MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (i : ι), ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord (ψ i)) →
    (∀ (i : ι), (Singularity.pointChart j t) (ψ i) = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * ψ' i) →
      (∀ (i : ι), ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord (ψ' i)) →
        Module.finrank k ↥(⨅ i, Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) (ψ' i))) ≤
          Module.finrank k ↥(⨅ i, Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) (ψ i)))

Singularity.finrank_le_finrank_of_mem_of.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [Fintype σ] {T T' : Submodule k (σ → k)} {j : σ} {v : σ → k},
  v ∈ T → v j ≠ 0 → (∀ w ∈ T', w j = 0 → w ∈ T) → Module.finrank k ↥T' ≤ Module.finrank k ↥T

Singularity.finrank_logJacobianDirectrix.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                Singularity.idealOrd
                      (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree
                            (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                          m +
                        1) →
                  Module.finrank k
                      ↥(Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                          (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) ≤
                    Module.finrank k ↥(Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix Δ g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                  Singularity.idealOrd
                        (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                          (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                      ↑(Finsupp.degree
                            (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                          d) →
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) ≠ 0 →
                      Module.finrank k
                          ↥(Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) ≤
                        Module.finrank k ↥(Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix Δ g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
                Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
                  Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                    (∀ i ∈ Δ, i ≠ j → t i = 0) →
                      Module.finrank k
                          ↥(Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)

Singularity.hasse_pointChart.type:

Singularity.homogeneousComponent_X_mul.type:

Singularity.homogeneousComponent_X_pow_a.type:

Singularity.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero.type:

Singularity.homogeneousComponent_monomia.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),

Singularity.homogeneousComponent_mul_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},

    ∀ (a : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) (a * f) =
        MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.constantCoeff a) * (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) f

Singularity.homogeneousComponent_pderiv.type:

Singularity.homogeneousComponent_smul_ad.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (d : ℕ) (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),

Singularity.homogeneousComponent_sum_smu.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (d : ℕ) (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) (∑ i, (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G)) =
    ↑(Finsupp.degree r + d) • (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) G

Singularity.homogeneousComponent_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) (Singularity.zMonic m a) =

Singularity.idealOrd_derivIdeal_iterate.type:

Singularity.idealOrd_derivIdeal_of_ne_ze.type:

Singularity.idealOrd_idealOfVars.type:

Singularity.idealOrd_le_ord.type:

Singularity.idealOrd_logJacobianTangent_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)

                        Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →

                            Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g') →
                          Singularity.idealOrd
                              (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)

                                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                                d)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},

    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      (Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
          ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g ↔
        Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
        ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 → Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = Singularity.ord g

Singularity.idealOrd_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.idealOrd (I * J) = Singularity.idealOrd I + Singularity.idealOrd J

Singularity.idealOrd_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R))
  (n : ℕ), Singularity.idealOrd (I ^ n) = n • Singularity.idealOrd I

Singularity.idealOrd_residualLogJacobian.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ r G) = 0 ↔
    (∃ i ∈ Δ, ↑(r i) * MvPolynomial.constantCoeff G ≠ 0) ∨
      ∃ j ∉ Δ, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G) ≠ 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} (r : σ →₀ ℕ) {G : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.ord G = ↑d →
    (Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ r G) < ↑d ↔
      ∃ j ∉ Δ, (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) G) ≠ 0)

Singularity.idealOrd_span_eq_zero_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {S : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.span S) = 0 ↔ ∃ s ∈ S, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff s ≠ 0

Singularity.idealOrd_span_singleton.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.span {f}) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.idealOrd_sup.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.idealOrd (I ⊔ J) = min (Singularity.idealOrd I) (Singularity.idealOrd J)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),

Singularity.initialForm_ne_zero.type:

Singularity.injective_prod_pow_of_linear.type:

Singularity.inseparable_xChart.type:

∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]

    W.valuation (z - 1) < 1 →
      (∀ σ ∉ ValuationSubring.decompositionSubgroup K W, W.valuation (σ z) < 1) →
        z ∈ W ∧

            W.valuation ((Polynomial.aeval z) (Polynomial.derivative (minpoly K z))) = 1

  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {V : ValuationSubring K} {K₀ : IntermediateField k K} {x : ι → ↥K₀} {y : κ → ↥K₀},
  IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range x ∪ Set.range y) = ⊤ →
    (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
      (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial (fun i => ↑(x i)) a) = 1 → a = 0) →
        Singularity.IsMonomialValuation (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range y))) (V.comap (algebraMap (↥K₀) K)) x

∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {V : ValuationSubring K} {x : ι → K} {y : κ → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0) →
      Singularity.IsMonomialValuation
        (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun j => Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k (Sum.elim x y) (Sum.inr j))))
        (V.comap (algebraMap (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x y)))) K)) fun i =>
        Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k (Sum.elim x y) (Sum.inl i)

      (AdjoinRoot.mk P) (Polynomial.derivative P) ∉ Q →
        ∀ (p : Ideal A) [inst_3 : p.IsPrime],
          Ideal.comap (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot P)) Q = p →
            IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p) → IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)

∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K}
  (A : Subalgebra k K) (h : ∀ (a : ↥A), ↑a ∈ V),
  IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (Singularity.valuationCenter V A h)) ↔

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {S : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommRing S] {φ : S →+* K},

∀ {F : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] {M : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : Field M] [inst_4 : Algebra F M] [inst_5 : Algebra M E] [IsScalarTower F M E] [FiniteDimensional F E]
  [Normal F E] [Normal M E],
  (∀ (σ : Gal(E/M)), σ = 1) →

  [IsGalois K L] (W : ValuationSubring L),
  (∀ (σ : Gal(L/K)), ∀ x ∈ W, σ x ∈ W) →
    Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) W.valuation).valuationSubring)
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
          ↥(Valuation.comap (algebraMap (↥(Singularity.inertiaField K W)) L) W.valuation).valuationSubring) ∧
      Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) W.valuation).valuationSubring)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
            ↥(Valuation.comap (algebraMap (↥(Singularity.inertiaField K W)) L) W.valuation).valuationSubring) =
        Module.finrank K ↥(Singularity.inertiaField K W)

  Singularity.IsSingularPoint h v ↔ (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0 ∧ Singularity.IsCriticalPoint h v

Singularity.isSingularPoint_purelyInsepa.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (h : MvPolynomial σ k) (z : k) (v : σ → k),
  (Singularity.IsSingularPoint (Singularity.purelyInseparable p h) fun o => o.elim z v) ↔
    z ^ p + (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0 ∧ Singularity.IsCriticalPoint h v

Singularity.isSncAt_of_isRegularLocalRin.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsRegularLocalRing R] (P : Ideal R) [IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ P)],
  ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) + 1 = ringKrullDim R → Singularity.IsSncAt P

Singularity.isSncAt_top.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsRegularLocalRing R], Singularity.IsSncAt ⊤

Singularity.isSncDivisor_of_codim_one.type:
∀ {Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme},
  Singularity.IsRegularScheme Z → ∀ {D : Z.IdealSheafData}, Singularity.IsRegularCodimOne D → Singularity.IsSncDivisor D

Singularity.isSolvableVertex_X_pow_add_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  (F : MvPowerSeries σ k) (v : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  Singularity.IsSolvableVertex (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C F) v c ↔ (MvPowerSeries.coeff (p • v)) F = c ^ p

Singularity.isVariety_p1Hypersurface.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ} (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k),
  AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced (Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g) →
    Singularity.IsVariety (Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g) (Singularity.p1Structure k p n g)

Singularity.isWeightedHomogeneous_initia.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w (Singularity.initialForm w f) (Singularity.weightedOrd w f).toNat

Singularity.iterate_divByMonic_eq_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → 0 < φ.natDegree → ∀ {f : Polynomial K} {N : ℕ}, f.natDegree < N → (fun g => g /ₘ φ)^[N] f = 0

Singularity.iterate_divByMonic_zero.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (j : ℕ), (fun g => g /ₘ φ)^[j] 0 = 0

Singularity.kangarooPath_of_codim_le_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [inst_3 : Fintype σ]
  {p : ℕ} [CharP k p] {m : ℕ} {P Q R : Finset σ × MvPolynomial σ k},
  Relation.TransGen (fun A B => Singularity.RhoStep p m A B ∧ Singularity.IsLogJacobianCaseB B) P Q →
    Singularity.RhoStep p m Q R →
      Singularity.IsLogJacobianCaseA R →
        Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim P.1 P.2 ≤ 1 →
          Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim P.1 P.2 ≤ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim R.1 R.2

Singularity.keyPolynomial_X_monomialValu.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, Singularity.KeyPolynomial (Singularity.monomialValuation v γ) Polynomial.X

Singularity.keyPolynomial_macLaneChainKe.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {n : ℕ},
      Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n ≠ ν →
        Singularity.KeyPolynomial (Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n) (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n)

Singularity.keyPolynomial_macLaneKey.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  Singularity.MacLaneBelow ν μ → μ ≠ ν → Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ (Singularity.macLaneKey ν μ)

Singularity.keyPolynomial_of_map_le_of_n.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w f) →
    φ.Monic →
      ν φ < w φ →
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = w f) →
          ∀ {ψ : Polynomial K},
            ψ.Monic →
              ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree →
                ν ψ ≤ ν φ →
                  w ψ = w φ ∧
                    ν ψ < w ψ ∧ (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < ψ.degree → ν f = w f) ∧ Singularity.KeyPolynomial w ψ

Singularity.keyPolynomial_of_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ μ f) →
    φ.Monic → ν φ < μ φ → (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) → Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ

Singularity.killOutside.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.killOutside_X_of_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i : σ},
  i ∈ S → (Singularity.killOutside S) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X i

Singularity.killOutside_comp_centerChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k),
      (Singularity.killOutside S).comp (Singularity.centerChart S j t) =
        (Singularity.pointChart j fun i => if i ∈ S then t i else 0).comp (Singularity.killOutside S)

Singularity.killOutside_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.killOutside S) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) =
    if ∀ i ∈ a.support, i ∈ S then (MvPolynomial.monomial a) c else 0

Singularity.killVar.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.killVarOpt.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.killVarOpt_comp_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ),
  (Singularity.killVarOpt j).comp (MvPolynomial.rename some) = (MvPolynomial.rename some).comp (Singularity.killVar j)

Singularity.killVarOpt_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {w : σ → k},
  w j = 0 →
    (Singularity.killVarOpt j).comp (Singularity.translate w) = (Singularity.translate w).comp (Singularity.killVar j)

Singularity.killVarSwap.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.killVarSwap_comp_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i : σ),
  (Singularity.killVarSwap i).comp (MvPolynomial.rename some) = Singularity.killVar i

Singularity.killVarSwap_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i : σ),
  (Singularity.killVarSwap i).comp (Singularity.translate (Pi.single i 1)) = AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.killVar_chartTransform.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {m : ℕ}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f →
    (Singularity.killVar j) (Singularity.chartTransform j t m f) =
      (Singularity.chartRest j t) (∑ a ∈ f.support with Finsupp.degree a = m, (MvPolynomial.monomial a) (f.coeff a))

Singularity.killVar_comp_chartRest.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.killVar j).comp (Singularity.chartRest j t) = Singularity.chartRest j t

Singularity.killVar_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.killVar i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) = if a i = 0 then (MvPolynomial.monomial a) c else 0

Singularity.krullDim_eq_natCard_sub_one.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder α] [Finite α] [Nonempty α],
  (∀ (a b : α), a ≤ b ∨ b ≤ a) → Order.krullDim α = ↑(Nat.card α - 1)

Singularity.latticeLemma.type:
∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι]
  (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ Γ) (D : Finset Γ),
  (∀ d ∈ D, 0 ≤ d) → ∃ m, (∀ (i : ι), 0 < m i) ∧ ∀ d ∈ D, ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ (m.repr d) i

Singularity.latticeLemma_of_injective.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {G : Type u_3} [inst_2 : AddCommGroup G]
  [inst_3 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] (w : (ι → ℤ) →+ G),
  Function.Injective ⇑w →
    ∀ (E : Finset (ι → ℤ)),
      (∀ a ∈ E, 0 ≤ w a) →
        ∃ B C, B * C = 1 ∧ C * B = 1 ∧ (∀ (l : ι), 0 < w (B l)) ∧ ∀ a ∈ E, ∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ Matrix.vecMul a C l

Singularity.latticeLemma_real.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (γ : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), ∑ i, ↑(a i) * γ i = 0 → a = 0) →
    ∀ (E : Finset (ι → ℤ)),
      (∀ a ∈ E, 0 ≤ ∑ i, ↑(a i) * γ i) →
        ∃ B C,
          B * C = 1 ∧ C * B = 1 ∧ (∀ (l : ι), 0 < ∑ i, ↑(B l i) * γ i) ∧ ∀ a ∈ E, ∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ Matrix.vecMul a C l

Singularity.latticeLemma_real_of_pos.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (γ : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 < γ i) →
    (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), ∑ i, ↑(a i) * γ i = 0 → a = 0) →
      ∀ (E : Finset (ι → ℤ)),
        (∀ a ∈ E, 0 ≤ ∑ i, ↑(a i) * γ i) →
          ∃ B C,
            B * C = 1 ∧ C * B = 1 ∧ (∀ (l : ι), 0 < ∑ i, ↑(B l i) * γ i) ∧ ∀ a ∈ E, ∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ Matrix.vecMul a C l

Singularity.laurentMonomial.type: {K : Type u_1} → [Field K] → {ι : Type u_2} → [Fintype ι] → (ι → K) → (ι → ℤ) → K

Singularity.laurentMonomial_add.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (a b : ι → ℤ),
      Singularity.laurentMonomial x (a + b) = Singularity.laurentMonomial x a * Singularity.laurentMonomial x b

Singularity.laurentMonomial_eq_units.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K} (hx : ∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) (a : ι → ℤ),
  Singularity.laurentMonomial x a = ↑(∏ i, Units.mk0 (x i) ⋯ ^ a i)

Singularity.laurentMonomial_natCast.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (x : ι → K) (β : ι →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.laurentMonomial x fun i => ↑(β i)) = ∏ i, x i ^ β i

Singularity.laurentMonomial_ne_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) → ∀ (a : ι → ℤ), Singularity.laurentMonomial x a ≠ 0

Singularity.laurentMonomial_single.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (x : ι → K) (i : ι),
  Singularity.laurentMonomial x (Pi.single i 1) = x i

Singularity.laurentMonomial_sub.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (a b : ι → ℤ),
      Singularity.laurentMonomial x (a - b) = Singularity.laurentMonomial x a / Singularity.laurentMonomial x b

Singularity.laurentMonomial_vecMul.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (n : ι → ℤ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℤ),
      Singularity.laurentMonomial x (Matrix.vecMul n B) =
        Singularity.laurentMonomial (fun l => Singularity.laurentMonomial x (B l)) n

Singularity.laurentMonomial_zero.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (x : ι → K), Singularity.laurentMonomial x 0 = 1

Singularity.le_augmentedValuationFun.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      ∀ (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
        μ (Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j) * γ ^ j ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f

Singularity.le_centerSubring.type: ∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} (R : Subring K), R ≤ Singularity.centerSubring V R

Singularity.le_degree_of_mem_support.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {m : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f → ∀ {a : σ →₀ ℕ}, a ∈ f.support → m ≤ Finsupp.degree a

Singularity.le_derivIdeal.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)), I ≤ Singularity.derivIdeal I

Singularity.le_directrix_homogeneousComp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {S : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ s ∈ S, ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord s) →
    ∀ {W : Submodule k (σ → k)},
      (∀ s ∈ S, W ≤ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) s)) →
        ∀ {f : MvPolynomial σ k}, f ∈ Ideal.span S → W ≤ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) f)

Singularity.le_directrix_of_mem_span.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {W : Submodule k (σ → k)} {S : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  (∀ s ∈ S, W ≤ Singularity.directrix s) →
    ∀ {F : MvPolynomial σ k}, F ∈ Submodule.span k S → W ≤ Singularity.directrix F

Singularity.le_divisorExponent.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {N : σ →₀ ℕ},
  P ≠ 0 → (∀ i ∉ Δ, N i = 0) → (∀ β ∈ P.support, N ≤ β) → N ≤ Singularity.divisorExponent Δ P

Singularity.le_divisorExponent_of_logJac.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ∀ {s : σ →₀ ℕ},
        (∀ i ∉ Δ, s i = 0) →
          Singularity.logJacobian Δ g ≤ Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial s) 1} → s ≤ Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g

Singularity.le_idealOrd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ f ∈ I, n ≤ Singularity.ord f) → n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I

Singularity.le_idealOrd_derivIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I → ↑(n - 1) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.derivIdeal I)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iSup_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_3} (I : ι → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) (n : ℕ),
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (⨆ j, I j) ↔ ∀ (j : ι), ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (I j)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iSup_pow_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type u_3}
  (B : ι → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) (c : ι → ℕ) {N : ℕ},
  1 ≤ N →
    (∀ (j : ι), c j ∣ N) →
      (↑N ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (⨆ j, B j ^ (N / c j)) ↔ ∀ (j : ι), ↑(c j) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (B j))

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I ↔ I ≤ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iff_one_le_ideal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [Fintype σ] [CharZero k] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m → (↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I ↔ 1 ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.derivIdeal^[m - 1] I))

Singularity.le_idealOrd_logJacobianTange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord g → ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.idealOrd I + Singularity.idealOrd J ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (I * J)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_span.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {S : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ s ∈ S, n ≤ Singularity.ord s) → n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.span S)

Singularity.le_logJacobianDirectrix.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {W : Submodule k (σ → k)},
  (∀ ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixSet Δ g,
      W ≤ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g).toNat) ψ)) →
    W ≤ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix Δ g

Singularity.le_logJacobianFullDirectrix.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {W : Submodule k (σ → k)},
  (∀ ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrixSet Δ g,
      W ≤ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g).toNat) ψ)) →
    W ≤ Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrix Δ g

Singularity.le_monomialValuationFun.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f : Polynomial K) (i : ℕ), v (f.coeff i) * γ ^ i ≤ Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f

Singularity.le_of_mem_support_monomial_m.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {N β : σ →₀ ℕ} {Q : MvPolynomial σ k},
  β ∈ ((MvPolynomial.monomial N) 1 * Q).support → N ≤ β

Singularity.le_of_mem_support_of_pointCh.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {q d : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.ord (F.divMonomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) = ↑d →
    q ≤ Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ q * F' →
        ∀ {β : σ →₀ ℕ},
          β ∈ F'.support →
            Finsupp.single j (Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d - q) +
                Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) ≤
              β

Singularity.le_of_ofPrime_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {P : Ideal ↥A} [inst_1 : P.IsPrime],
  LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring → A ≤ V.toSubring

Singularity.le_of_strictMono.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] {r : ℕ},
  Module.rank ℚ (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ (Additive G)) = ↑r →
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (f : Fin (t + 1) → Subgroup G),
      StrictMono f → (∀ (i : Fin (t + 1)), Singularity.IsConvexSubgroup (f i)) → t ≤ r

Singularity.le_ordAlong.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {n : ℕ∞}, (∀ d ∈ f.support, n ≤ ↑(∑ i ∈ S, d i)) → n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f

Singularity.le_ordAlong_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {n : ℕ∞}, n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f → n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S g → n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (f + g)

Singularity.le_ordAlong_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {n : ℕ∞}, n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f ↔ ∀ d ∈ f.support, n ≤ ↑(∑ i ∈ S, d i)

Singularity.le_ordAlong_iff_mem_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Nontrivial R] {S : Finset σ}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ}, ↑n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f ↔ f ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ n

Singularity.le_ordAlong_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ)
  (f g : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ordAlong S f + Singularity.ordAlong S g ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (f * g)

Singularity.le_ord_X_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℕ∞},
  n ≤ Singularity.ord f → ∀ (m : σ), n ≤ Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X m * f)

Singularity.le_ord_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  n ≤ Singularity.ord f → n ≤ Singularity.ord g → n ≤ Singularity.ord (f + g)

Singularity.le_ord_homogeneousComponent.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (m : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f)

Singularity.le_ord_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord f ↔ ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree d < n → f.coeff d = 0

Singularity.le_ord_iff_mem_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord f ↔ f ∈ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n

Singularity.le_ord_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f + Singularity.ord g ≤ Singularity.ord (f * g)

Singularity.le_ord_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {G : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  ↑d ≤ Singularity.ord G → ∀ (j : σ), ↑(d - 1) ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G)

Singularity.le_ord_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ),
  n • Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord (f ^ n)

Singularity.le_ord_smul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord (a • f)

Singularity.le_ord_smul_add_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {G : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  ↑d ≤ Singularity.ord G →
    ∀ (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ), ↑d ≤ Singularity.ord (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
    ∀ {i : σ},
      i ∈ Δ →
        ↑d ≤
          Singularity.ord
            (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
              MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g))

Singularity.le_ord_translate_zMonic_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ},
  IsUnit ↑m →
    ∀ {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
      a (m - 1) = 0 →
        ∀ (b : Option σ → R),
          ↑m ≤
              Singularity.ord
                ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C (b o)) (Singularity.zMonic m a)) ↔
            b none = 0 ∧
              ∀ i < m,
                ↑(m - i) ≤
                  Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun l => MvPolynomial.X l + MvPolynomial.C (b (some l))) (a i))

Singularity.le_ord_zMonic_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ} {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.zMonic m a) ↔ ∀ i < m, ↑(m - i) ≤ Singularity.ord (a i)

Singularity.linearChange.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → [Fintype σ] → Matrix σ σ R → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.linearChange_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (A : Matrix σ σ R) (i : σ),
  (Singularity.linearChange A) (MvPolynomial.X i) = ∑ j, MvPolynomial.C (A i j) * MvPolynomial.X j

Singularity.linearChange_linearChange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (A B : Matrix σ σ R)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.linearChange A) ((Singularity.linearChange B) f) = (Singularity.linearChange (B * A)) f

Singularity.linearChange_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ]
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R), (Singularity.linearChange 1) f = f

Singularity.linearIndependent_of_linearI.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] (V : ValuationSubring K)
  {E : IntermediateField k K} {F : Type u_3} [inst_3 : Field F] [inst_4 : Algebra F (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)],
  (∀ (c : ↥E) (hc : ↑c ∈ V), ∃ f, (algebraMap F (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)) f = (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) ⟨↑c, hc⟩) →
    ∀ {m : Type u_4} [Fintype m] {z : m → ↥V},
      (LinearIndependent F fun i => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (z i)) → LinearIndependent ↥E fun i => ↑(z i)

Singularity.linearIndependent_of_residue.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {E' : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field E'] [inst_2 : Algebra E E'] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
  (v₀ : Valuation E Γ₀) (v : Valuation E' Γ) [inst_5 : v₀.HasExtension v] {ι : Type u_5} (b : ι → ↥v.valuationSubring),
  (LinearIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥v₀.valuationSubring) fun i =>
      (IsLocalRing.residue ↥v.valuationSubring) (b i)) →
    LinearIndependent E fun i => ↑(b i)

Singularity.linearIndependent_of_valuati.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] (V : ValuationSubring K)
  {E : IntermediateField k K} {m : Type u_3} [Fintype m] {z : m → K},
  (∀ (i : m), z i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (i j : m) (c d : ↥E), c ≠ 0 → d ≠ 0 → V.valuation (↑c * z i) = V.valuation (↑d * z j) → i = j) →
      LinearIndependent (↥E) z

Singularity.linearIndependent_valuation_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (V : ValuationSubring K) {x : ι → K}
  (hx0 : ∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i => Additive.ofMul ((Units.map ↑V.valuation) (Units.mk0 (x i) ⋯))) ↔
    ∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0

Singularity.linearPartAt.type: {ι : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → [Fintype ι] → (ι → R) → MvPolynomial ι R → MvPolynomial ι R

Singularity.linearPartAt_mem.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (x : ι → R) (f : MvPolynomial ι R),

Singularity.logJacobian.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.logJacobianCaseIdeal_le_logJ.type:

Singularity.logJacobianCaseIdeal_of_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
      ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g →
    Singularity.logJacobianCaseIdeal Δ g = Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g

Singularity.logJacobianCaseIdeal_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) ≠
      ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g →
    Singularity.logJacobianCaseIdeal Δ g = Singularity.logJacobian Δ g

Singularity.logJacobianCenter.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →

Singularity.logJacobianCenter_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ S : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),

Singularity.logJacobianCenter_univ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),

Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → Submodule k (σ → k)

Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [Fintype σ] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ

Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = 0 → Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim Δ g = 0

Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [inst_3 : Fintype σ]
  (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                Singularity.idealOrd
                      (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree
                            (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                          m +
                        1) →
                  Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim Δ g ≤
                    Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [inst_3 : Fintype σ]
  (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                  Singularity.idealOrd
                        (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                          (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                      ↑(Finsupp.degree
                            (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                          d) →
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) ≠ 0 →
                      Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim Δ g ≤
                        Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                          (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [inst_3 : Fintype σ]
  (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
                Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
                  Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                    (∀ i ∈ Δ, i ≠ j → t i = 0) →
                      Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim Δ g ≤
                        Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                          (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [inst_3 : Fintype σ]
  (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                  ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) ≠ 0 →
                    Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim Δ g ≤
                      Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                        (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [inst_3 : Fintype σ]
  (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                (∀ i ∈ Δ, i ≠ j → t i = 0) →
                  Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) p g' =
                      Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g →
                    Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim Δ g ≤
                      Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                        (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim Δ g ≤ Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrixCodim Δ g

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Fintype σ] [inst_3 : DecidableEq k]
  (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →

            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim Δ g ≤
                  Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrixCodim (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [inst_3 : Fintype σ]
  {p : ℕ} [CharP k p] {m : ℕ} {P Q R : Finset σ × MvPolynomial σ k},

    Singularity.RhoStep p m Q R →
      Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim P.1 P.2 ≤ Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrixCodim R.1 R.2

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [inst_3 : Fintype σ]
  {p : ℕ} [CharP k p] {m : ℕ} {P Q : Finset σ × MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.RhoStep p m P Q →
    Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim P.1 P.2 ≤ Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrixCodim Q.1 Q.2

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {m : ℕ} {P R : Finset σ × MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder P.1 P.2 = ↑m →
    Singularity.logJacobianOrder R.1 R.2 = ↑m →
      Singularity.IsLogJacobianCaseA R →
        Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim P.1 P.2 ≤ 1 →
          Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim P.1 P.2 ≤ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim R.1 R.2

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [inst_3 : Fintype σ]
  {p : ℕ} [CharP k p] {m : ℕ} {P Q : Finset σ × MvPolynomial σ k},

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p]
  {Δ S : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},

        ∀ {ρ : ℕ},

                ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ ρ,
                  f = (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * q) →

                    ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ (ρ + 1),
                      f = (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * q) ∨
                  ∃ q,

                        Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g ∧
                      Singularity.ord q = ↑ρ) →

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p]
  {Δ S : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  j ∈ S →
    g ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ p →
      (Singularity.centerChart S j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
        ∀ {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
          (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
            ∀ {s ρ : ℕ},
              (∀ f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g,
                  ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ s, f = (MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * q) →
                ∀ {q : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  (MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * q ∈ Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g →
                    Singularity.ord q = ↑s →
                      Singularity.ord ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) q) ≤ ↑(s + ρ) →
                        Singularity.cleanPart p g' ≠ 0 ∧
                          Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                            ↑ρ

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
