      Singularity.macLaneChain v ν (n + 1) ≠ ν →
        (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν (n + 1)).natDegree = (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n).natDegree →
          ν (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν (n + 1)) < ν (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n)

Singularity.map_modByMonic_le_augmentedV.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  φ.Monic → 0 < φ.natDegree → ∀ (f : Polynomial K), μ (f %ₘ φ) ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f

Singularity.map_pointChart_logJacobianTa.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ]
  (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Ideal.map (Singularity.pointChart j t) (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) ≤
    Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ]
  (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
    Ideal.map (Singularity.pointChart j t) (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) ≤
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X j ^ p} * Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) g'

Singularity.map_sub_le_of_map_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
      ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → ν φ ≤ ν ψ → μ (ψ - φ) ≤ ν ψ

Singularity.mem_alongIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n : ℕ∞}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ R}, f ∈ Singularity.alongIdeal S n ↔ n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f

Singularity.mem_blowupDivisor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {i : σ}, i ∈ Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t ↔ i = j ∨ i ∈ Δ ∧ i ≠ j ∧ t i = 0

Singularity.mem_boundedSubgroup.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [inst_2 : IsOrderedMonoid G] {a x : G},
  x ∈ Singularity.boundedSubgroup a ↔ ∃ n, |x|ₘ ≤ a ^ n

Singularity.mem_centerDegreeIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S n ↔ ∀ a ∈ f.support, n ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, a i

Singularity.mem_centerDivisor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k]
  {Δ S : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {i : σ},
  i ∈ Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t ↔ i = j ∨ i ∈ Δ ∧ i ≠ j ∧ (i ∉ S ∨ t i = 0)

Singularity.mem_centerIdeal.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {hA : A ≤ V.toSubring} {a : ↥A},
  a ∈ Singularity.centerIdeal V A hA ↔ V.valuation ↑a < 1

Singularity.mem_centerSubring.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {R : Subring K} {z : K},
  z ∈ Singularity.centerSubring V R ↔ ∃ a ∈ R, ∃ c ∈ R, V.valuation c = 1 ∧ z * c = a

Singularity.mem_comap_adjoin_sumElim_of_.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4}
  {V : ValuationSubring K} [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {x : ι → K} {y : κ → ↥V},
  (AlgebraicIndependent k fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y j)) →
    ∀
      c ∈
        IntermediateField.adjoin k
          (Set.range fun j => Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j)) (Sum.inr j)),
      c ∈ V.comap (algebraMap (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j))))) K)

Singularity.mem_comap_of_mem_adjoin.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {κ : Type u_4}
  {V : ValuationSubring K} {K₀ : IntermediateField k K} {y : κ → ↥K₀},
  (∀ c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun j => ↑(y j)), c ∈ V) →
    ∀ c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range y), c ∈ V.comap (algebraMap (↥K₀) K)

Singularity.mem_directrixPolys_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {v : σ → k} {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  F ∈ Singularity.directrixPolys v ↔ v ∈ Singularity.directrix F

Singularity.mem_directrix_X_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {i : σ} {w : σ → k},
  w ∈ Singularity.directrix (MvPolynomial.X i) ↔ w i = 0

Singularity.mem_directrix_X_pow_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {i : σ} {n : ℕ},
  n ≠ 0 → ∀ {w : σ → k}, w ∈ Singularity.directrix (MvPolynomial.X i ^ n) ↔ w i = 0

Singularity.mem_directrix_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {v : σ → k},
  v ∈ Singularity.directrix g ↔ (Singularity.translate v) g = (MvPolynomial.rename some) g

Singularity.mem_directrix_killVar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {w : σ → k},
  w j = 0 →
    ∀ {F : MvPolynomial σ k}, w ∈ Singularity.directrix F → w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((Singularity.killVar j) F)

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_isHomogeneo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {m : ℕ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g.IsHomogeneous m →
    ((Singularity.chartRest j t) g).IsHomogeneous m → Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix g

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_le_ord_poin.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' →
      ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f' →
        Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f)

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_mem_directr.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t w : σ → k},
  w j = 0 →
    ∀ {F : MvPolynomial σ k}, w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((Singularity.chartLinear j t) F) → w ∈ Singularity.directrix F

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' →
      ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f' →
        ∀ {w : σ → k},
          w j = 0 →
            w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f') →
              w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f)

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_mem_logJaco.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                Singularity.idealOrd
                      (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree
                          (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                        d) →
                  ∀ {ψ f' : MvPolynomial σ k},
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑d →
                      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈
                          Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                        (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ) =
                            MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * f' →
                          f' ∈
                              Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                (Singularity.cleanPart p g') →
                            ∀ {w : σ → k},
                              w ∈
                                  Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g') →
                                w j = 0 → w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) ψ)

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_ord_pointCh.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ},
  Singularity.ord f = ↑m →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' →
      Singularity.ord f' = ↑m →
        Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f)

Singularity.mem_directrix_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {F : MvPolynomial σ k} {v : σ → k},
  v ∈ Singularity.directrix F → ∀ (i : σ), v ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) F)

Singularity.mem_idealOfSubgroup.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (H : Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ) (x : ↥V),
  x ∈ Singularity.idealOfSubgroup V H ↔ ∀ h ∈ H, V.valuation ↑x < ↑h

Singularity.mem_idealOfVars_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  f ∈ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ↔ MvPolynomial.constantCoeff f = 0

Singularity.mem_iff_valuation_lt_one_of_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {A : Subring K} {P : Ideal ↥A} [inst_1 : P.IsPrime] {V : ValuationSubring K},
  LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring → ∀ (a : ↥A), a ∈ P ↔ V.valuation ↑a < 1

Singularity.mem_inertiaField_iff.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {W : ValuationSubring L}
  (x : L), x ∈ Singularity.inertiaField K W ↔ ∀ σ ∈ Singularity.inertiaGroup K W, σ x = x

Singularity.mem_inertiaGroup_iff.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {W : ValuationSubring L}
  {σ : Gal(L/K)}, σ ∈ Singularity.inertiaGroup K W ↔ (∀ (x : L), σ x ∈ W ↔ x ∈ W) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, W.valuation (σ x - x) < 1

Singularity.mem_maximalIdeal_of_valuatio.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {R : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : IsLocalRing R] [inst_3 : Algebra R K]
  (V : ValuationSubring K) (hRV : ∀ (r : R), (algebraMap R K) r ∈ V)
  [inst_4 : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)],
  (∀ (r : R),
      (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)) ((IsLocalRing.residue R) r) =
        (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) ⟨(algebraMap R K) r, ⋯⟩) →
    ∀ {n : Type u_3} [inst_5 : Fintype n] {z : n → R} {j : n},
      (algebraMap R K) (z j) ≠ 0 →
        ∀ {u : n → ↥V},
          (∀ (i : n), ↑(u i) * (algebraMap R K) (z j) = (algebraMap R K) (z i)) →
            (LinearIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) fun i => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (u i)) →
              ∀ (c : n → R),
                V.valuation ((algebraMap R K) (∑ i, c i * z i)) < V.valuation ((algebraMap R K) (z j)) →
                  ∀ (i : n), c i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R

Singularity.mem_maximalIdeal_valuationSu.type:
∀ {L : Type u_5} {Γ : Type u_6} [inst : Field L] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] (w : Valuation L Γ)
  (b : ↥w.valuationSubring), b ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥w.valuationSubring ↔ w ↑b < 1

Singularity.mem_of_mem_adjoin_residue.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K}
  [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {κ : Type u_3} {y : κ → ↥V},
  (AlgebraicIndependent k fun i => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y i)) →
    ∀ {c : K}, c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun i => ↑(y i)) → c ∈ V

Singularity.mem_of_mem_support_of_degree.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n : ℕ} {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Finsupp.degree a = n → n ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, a i → ∀ i ∈ a.support, i ∈ S

Singularity.mem_pointIdeal_sq_iff.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [Fintype ι] (x : ι → R) (f : MvPolynomial ι R),
  f ∈ Singularity.pointIdeal x ^ 2 ↔
    (MvPolynomial.eval x) f = 0 ∧ ∀ (i : ι), (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f) = 0

Singularity.mem_purelyInseparableExtensi.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ)
  [inst_3 : ExpChar K p] [inst_4 : IsPurelyInseparable K L] (V : ValuationSubring K) (b : L),
  b ∈ Singularity.purelyInseparableExtension p V ↔ ∃ n, ∃ y ∈ V, (algebraMap K L) y = b ^ p ^ n

Singularity.mem_regularLocus_iff_of_isAf.type:
∀ {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {U : X.Opens} (hU : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U) (x : ↥U),
  ↑x ∈ Singularity.regularLocus X ↔
    hU.primeIdealOf x ∈ Singularity.Algebra.regularLocus ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))

Singularity.mem_residualLogJacobianTange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
    ψ ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobianTangent Δ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.mem_residualLogJacobian_of_m.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g →
    ψ ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.mem_subgroupOfIdeal.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (P : Ideal ↥V) [inst_1 : P.IsPrime] (γ : V.ValueGroupˣ),
  γ ∈ Singularity.subgroupOfIdeal V P ↔ ∃ x ∉ P, V.valuation ↑x ≤ ↑γ ∧ V.valuation ↑x ≤ ↑γ⁻¹

Singularity.mem_subgroupToIntSubmodule.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] (H : Subgroup G) {y : Additive G},
  y ∈ Singularity.subgroupToIntSubmodule H ↔ Additive.toMul y ∈ H

Singularity.mem_support_initialForm.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  f ≠ 0 →
    (d ∈ (Singularity.initialForm w f).support ↔ d ∈ f.support ∧ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) = Singularity.weightedOrd w f)

Singularity.mem_support_monomial_add_lef.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {a b : σ →₀ ℕ},
  a ≠ b → a ∈ ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) 1 + (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1).support

Singularity.mem_support_monomial_add_rig.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {a b : σ →₀ ℕ},
  a ≠ b → b ∈ ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) 1 + (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1).support

Singularity.mem_support_of_mem_support_c.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {q : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {β : σ →₀ ℕ},
  β ∈ (Singularity.cleanPart q P).support → β ∈ P.support

Singularity.mem_valuationSubring_iff_of_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p]
  (V : ValuationSubring K) (W : ValuationSubring L),
  W.comap (algebraMap K L) = V → ∀ {b : L} {n : ℕ} {y : K}, (algebraMap K L) y = b ^ p ^ n → (b ∈ W ↔ y ∈ V)

Singularity.mem_valuationSubring_of_pow_.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {L : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field L]
  [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (V : ValuationSubring K) (W : ValuationSubring L),
  W.comap (algebraMap K L) = V → ∀ {x : K}, x ∈ V → ∀ {θ : L}, θ ^ p = (algebraMap K L) x → θ ∈ W

Singularity.min_le_ordAlong_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ)
  (f g : MvPolynomial σ R), min (Singularity.ordAlong S f) (Singularity.ordAlong S g) ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (f + g)

Singularity.min_ord_le_ord_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  min (Singularity.ord f) (Singularity.ord g) ≤ Singularity.ord (f + g)

Singularity.monomialValuation.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type u_2} → [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] → Valuation K Γ₀ → Γ₀ → Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀

Singularity.monomialValuationFun.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type u_2} → [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] → Valuation K Γ₀ → Γ₀ → Polynomial K → Γ₀

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_C.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (a : K), Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ (Polynomial.C a) = v a

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_X.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ Polynomial.X = γ

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_add_le_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f g : Polynomial K),
  Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ (f + g) ≤
    max (Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f) (Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ g)

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_mul.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f g : Polynomial K),
  Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ (f * g) =
    Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f * Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ g

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_mul_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f g : Polynomial K),
  Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ (f * g) ≤
    Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f * Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ g

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_one.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ 1 = 1

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ 0 = 0

Singularity.monomialValuation_C.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (a : K), (Singularity.monomialValuation v γ) (Polynomial.C a) = v a

Singularity.monomialValuation_X.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, (Singularity.monomialValuation v γ) Polynomial.X = γ

Singularity.monomialValuation_apply.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f : Polynomial K), (Singularity.monomialValuation v γ) f = Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f

Singularity.monomialValuation_eq_zero_if.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, γ ≠ 0 → ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, (Singularity.monomialValuation v γ) f = 0 ↔ f = 0

Singularity.monomial_mem_pow_varsIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (n : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : R),
  n ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, d i → (MvPolynomial.monomial d) c ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ n

Singularity.monomial_mul_chartUnit_mul_m.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {τ : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = ↑τ →
              ∀ {f ψ' : MvPolynomial σ k},
                f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                  (Singularity.pointChart j t) f =
                      MvPolynomial.X j ^ τ *
                        ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g))) 1 *
                          (Singularity.chartUnit j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) * ψ')) →
                    ∀ {m : ℕ},
                      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                        Singularity.ord ψ' = ↑m →
                          (MvPolynomial.monomial
                                  (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g')))
                                1 *
                              (Singularity.chartUnit j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) * ψ') ∈
                            Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

Singularity.monomial_mul_divMonomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ β ∈ P.support, r ≤ β) → (MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * P.divMonomial r = P

Singularity.monomial_mul_mem_logJacobian.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
        ∀ {τ : ℕ},
          Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = ↑τ →
            ∀ {f W : MvPolynomial σ k},
              f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                (Singularity.pointChart j t) f =
                    MvPolynomial.X j ^ τ *
                      ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g))) 1 *
                        W) →
                  (∀ i ∉ Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t,
                      (Finsupp.single j (τ - p) + Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) i =
                        0) ∧
                    Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                        Ideal.span
                          {(MvPolynomial.monomial
                                (Finsupp.single j (τ - p) +
                                  Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)))
                              1} ∧
                      (MvPolynomial.monomial
                              (Finsupp.single j (τ - p) +
                                Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)))
                            1 *
                          W ∈
                        Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

Singularity.monomial_mul_residualFactor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * Singularity.residualFactor Δ g = g

Singularity.monomial_mul_smul_add_X_mul_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {i : σ},
  i ∈ Δ →
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 *
        (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
          MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ∈
      Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g

Singularity.monomial_mul_sum_smul_add_X_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 *
      ∑ i,
        (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
          MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ∈
    Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g

Singularity.monomial_one_dvd_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {b : σ →₀ ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1 ∣ f ↔ ∀ a ∈ f.support, b ≤ a

Singularity.monomial_one_dvd_of_dvd_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {b : σ →₀ ℕ} {u f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff u ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1 ∣ u * f → (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1 ∣ f

Singularity.muDvd_X_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), μ f = Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f) →
    ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, Singularity.MuDvd μ Polynomial.X f ↔ v (f.coeff 0) < μ f

Singularity.muDvd_iff_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ μ f) →
    φ.Monic →
      ν φ < μ φ →
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
          ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, Singularity.MuDvd μ φ f ↔ ν f < μ f

Singularity.muDvd_iff_of_forall_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      ∀ {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f = Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f) →
          ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, Singularity.MuDvd ν φ f ↔ μ (f %ₘ φ) < ν f

Singularity.muDvd_mul_self.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ h : Polynomial K}, μ (φ * h) ≠ 0 → Singularity.MuDvd μ φ (φ * h)

Singularity.muDvd_of_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ μ f) →
    φ.Monic →
      ν φ < μ φ →
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
          ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, ν f < μ f → Singularity.MuDvd μ φ f

Singularity.muDvd_one_one.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀}, Singularity.MuDvd μ 1 1

Singularity.muEquiv_iff_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ν φ < μ φ →
      (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
        ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → (Singularity.MuEquiv μ φ ψ ↔ ν ψ < μ ψ)

Singularity.muEquiv_macLaneChainKey_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {n : ℕ},
      Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n ≠ ν →
        ∀ {ψ : Polynomial K},
          ψ.Monic →
            ψ.natDegree = (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n).natDegree →
              (Singularity.MuEquiv (Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n) (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n) ψ ↔
                ν ψ < (Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n) ψ)

Singularity.mul_mem_centerDegreeIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n m : ℕ}
  {f g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S n →
    g ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S m → f * g ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S (n + m)

Singularity.naiveCoeff.eq_def.type:
∀ (m x : ℕ),
  Singularity.naiveCoeff m x =
    match x with
    | 0 => m
    | 1 => m + 1
    | i.succ.succ => Singularity.naiveCoeff m i + Singularity.naiveCoeff m (i + 1) - m

Singularity.naiveCoeff_add.type: ∀ (m i : ℕ), Singularity.naiveCoeff m i + Singularity.naiveCoeff m (i + 1) = 2 * m + Nat.fib (i + 2)

Singularity.naiveCoeff_add_two.type: ∀ (m i : ℕ), Singularity.naiveCoeff m (i + 2) = Singularity.naiveCoeff m i + Singularity.naiveCoeff m (i + 1) - m

Singularity.naiveCoeff_eq.type: ∀ (m i : ℕ), Singularity.naiveCoeff m i = m + Nat.fib i

Singularity.naiveCoeff_one_two_three.type: ∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.naiveCoeff m 1 = m + 1 ∧ Singularity.naiveCoeff m 2 = m + 1 ∧ Singularity.naiveCoeff m 3 = m + 2

Singularity.narasimhanCoeff.type: (K : Type u_1) → [inst : Field K] → ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K

Singularity.narasimhan_le_ord_translate.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharP K 2],
  ↑2 ≤
    Singularity.ord
      ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C ((fun x => 1) o))
        (Singularity.zMonic 2 (Singularity.narasimhanCoeff K)))

Singularity.natCast_mul_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (a : ℕ) (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (MvPolynomial.monomial β) c * ↑a = (MvPolynomial.monomial β) (↑a * c)

Singularity.natCast_pow_char.type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {E : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing E] [CharP E p] (n : ℕ), ↑n ^ p = ↑n

Singularity.natCast_succ_le_ord_X_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord f → ∀ (m : σ), ↑(n + 1) ≤ Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X m * f)

Singularity.natCast_succ_le_ord_X_mul_pd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
    ∀ {l : σ},
      l ∉ Δ →
        ∀ (m : σ),
          ↑(d + 1) ≤ Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g))

Singularity.natCast_succ_le_ord_smul_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
    ∀ {l : σ},
      l ∉ Δ →
        ↑(d + 1) ≤
          Singularity.ord
            (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) l) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
              MvPolynomial.X l * (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g))

Singularity.natDegree_eq_of_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  ν φ < μ φ →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
      ν ψ < μ ψ → (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < ψ.degree → ν f = μ f) → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree

Singularity.natDegree_le_of_map_lt_augme.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
        ν ψ < Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ (ν φ) ψ → φ.natDegree ≤ ψ.natDegree

Singularity.natDegree_macLaneChainKey_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {F : Polynomial K},
      F ≠ 0 →
        ν F = 0 →
          ∀ {n : ℕ}, Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n ≠ ν → (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n).natDegree ≤ F.natDegree

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {n : ℕ},
      Singularity.macLaneChain v ν (n + 1) ≠ ν →
        (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n).natDegree ≤ (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν (n + 1)).natDegree

Singularity.ne_pow_of_isReduced.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CharP R p] (g : R),
  IsReduced (Polynomial R ⧸ Ideal.span {Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C g}) → ∀ (a : R), a ^ p ≠ g

Singularity.ne_zero_of_logJacobianOrder_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g ≠ ⊤ → g ≠ 0

Singularity.ne_zero_of_pointChart_eq_X_p.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ}, f ≠ 0 → (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' → f' ≠ 0

Singularity.ne_zero_of_valuation_eq_one.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {s : K}, V.valuation s = 1 → s ≠ 0

Singularity.nearPointExample_hyp.type:
MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4 ≠ 0 ∧
  Singularity.IsClean 3 (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) ∧
    ↑3 ≤ Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4)

Singularity.nearPointExample_not_mem_dir.type:
Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) = 1 ∧
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor {0} 1 0)
        (Singularity.cleanPart 3
          (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) =
      1 ∧
    (MvPolynomial.monomial
              (Singularity.divisorExponent {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4)))
            1 *
          (2 * MvPolynomial.X 1) ∈
        Singularity.logJacobian {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) ∧
      Singularity.ord (2 * MvPolynomial.X 1) = 1 ∧
        Singularity.chartVector 1 0 ∉
          Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent 1) (2 * MvPolynomial.X 1))

Singularity.nearPointExample_pointChart.type:
(Singularity.pointChart 1 0) (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) =
  MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3 * (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4 * MvPolynomial.X 1)

Singularity.nearPointExample_tangent.type:
(MvPolynomial.monomial
          (Singularity.divisorExponent {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4)))
        1 *
      MvPolynomial.X 0 ∈
    Singularity.logJacobianTangent {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) ∧
  Singularity.idealOrd
      (Singularity.logJacobianTangent {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4)) =
    ↑4

Singularity.neg_nextCoeff_pow_sub_of_dvd.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP F p] {a : F} {g : Polynomial F},
  g.Monic → g ∣ Singularity.artinSchreierPoly p a → (-g.nextCoeff) ^ p - -g.nextCoeff = ↑g.natDegree * a

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Set (σ → ℝ)

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_add_orthant.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f + Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_add_subset.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.newtonPolyhedron (f + g) ⊆
    (convexHull ℝ) (Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f ∪ Singularity.newtonPolyhedron g)

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_eq_convexHu.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f = (convexHull ℝ) (⇑Singularity.expToReal '' ↑f.support + Singularity.orthant σ)

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : R},
  c ≠ 0 → Singularity.newtonPolyhedron ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) c) = {Singularity.expToReal d} + Singularity.orthant σ

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_mul_subset.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.newtonPolyhedron (f * g) ⊆ Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f + Singularity.newtonPolyhedron g

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R], Singularity.newtonPolyhedron 0 = ∅

Singularity.nonempty_orderMonoidIso_mult.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] (f : G ≃* Multiplicative ℤ),

Singularity.nonempty_orderMonoidIso_of_b.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G]
  (b : Module.Basis (Fin 1) ℤ (Additive G)), Nonempty (G ≃*o Multiplicative ℤ)

Singularity.notMem_charPolyhedron_of_isS.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : k},
  v ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.expToReal v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) →
      Singularity.IsSolvableVertex f v c → Singularity.expToReal v ∉ Singularity.charPolyhedron f

Singularity.notMem_projPolyhedron_taylor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : k},
  Singularity.expToReal v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) →
    Singularity.IsSolvableVertex f v c →
      Singularity.expToReal v ∉ Singularity.projPolyhedron ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial v) (-c))) f)

Singularity.not_dvd_finrank_fixedField_s.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {L' : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field M] [inst_2 : Field L']
  [inst_3 : Algebra K M] [inst_4 : Algebra M L'] [inst_5 : Algebra K L'] [inst_6 : IsScalarTower K M L']
  [FiniteDimensional M L'] [IsGalois M L'] {ℓ p e : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime ℓ)],
  Nat.Prime p →
    p ≠ ℓ →
      Module.finrank K M = p ^ e → ∀ (P : Sylow ℓ Gal(L'/M)), ¬ℓ ∣ Module.finrank K ↥(IntermediateField.fixedField ↑P)

Singularity.not_isField_of_ne_top.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K}, V ≠ ⊤ → ¬IsField ↥V

Singularity.not_isResonant_initialForm.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (w : σ → ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ¬p ∣ (Singularity.weightedOrd w g).toNat → ¬Singularity.IsResonant p (Singularity.initialForm w g).support

Singularity.not_isResonant_of_isWeighted.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {w : σ → ℕ} {D : ℕ}
  {h : MvPolynomial σ R}, MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w h D → ¬p ∣ D → ¬Singularity.IsResonant p h.support

Singularity.not_isSingularPoint_X_pow.type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [IsReduced k] {τ : Type u_3} (i : τ) (n : ℕ) {u : τ → k},
  u i ≠ 0 → ¬Singularity.IsSingularPoint (MvPolynomial.X i ^ n) u

Singularity.not_isSolvableVertex_imperfe.type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] {t : k},
  (∀ (c : k), c ^ p ≠ t) →
    ∀ (c : k),
      ¬Singularity.IsSolvableVertex (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C (Singularity.imperfectF p t)) (Finsupp.single 0 1)
          c

Singularity.not_isSolvableVertex_of_char.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Singularity.charPolyhedron f = Singularity.projPolyhedron f →
    v ≠ 0 →
      Singularity.expToReal v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) →
        ∀ (c : k), ¬Singularity.IsSolvableVertex f v c

Singularity.not_isSolvableVertex_of_clea.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [Nontrivial k] (e : ℕ)
  {F : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  (∀ (α : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) F ≠ 0 → ¬∀ (i : σ), p ^ e ∣ α i) →
    ∀ {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
      v ≠ 0 →
        Singularity.expToReal v ∈
            Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C F)) →
          ∀ (c : k), ¬Singularity.IsSolvableVertex (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C F) v c

Singularity.not_isSolvableVertex_of_coef.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)},
  1 ≤ f.natDegree →
    IsUnit ↑f.natDegree →
      f.coeff (f.natDegree - 1) = 0 →
        ∀ {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
          Singularity.expToReal v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) →
            ∀ (c : k), ¬Singularity.IsSolvableVertex f v c

Singularity.not_muDvd_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} (φ : Polynomial K), ¬Singularity.MuDvd μ φ 0

Singularity.not_tschirnhausen_charTwo.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharP K 2],
  ¬∀ (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K) (b : Option (Fin 3) → K),
      a (m - 1) = 0 →
        (∀ i < m, ↑(m - i) ≤ Singularity.ord (a i)) →
          ↑m ≤
              Singularity.ord
                ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C (b o)) (Singularity.zMonic m a)) →
            b none = 0

Singularity.ofPrime_centerIdeal_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (A : Subring K) (hA : A ≤ V.toSubring),
  LocalSubring.ofPrime A (Singularity.centerIdeal V A hA) ≤ V.toLocalSubring

Singularity.ofPrime_le_of_mem_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {P : Ideal ↥A} [inst_1 : P.IsPrime],
  A ≤ V.toSubring → (∀ (a : ↥A), a ∈ P ↔ V.valuation ↑a < 1) → LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring

Singularity.one_add_X_pow_pow_mul.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (v b : ℕ),
  (1 + Polynomial.X) ^ (p ^ v * b) = (Polynomial.expand k (p ^ v)) ((1 + Polynomial.X) ^ b)

Singularity.one_le_logJacobianDirectrixC.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℕ},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
    m ≠ 0 → Singularity.IsLogJacobianCaseA (Δ, g) → 1 ≤ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixCodim Δ g

Singularity.one_le_ord_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  1 ≤ Singularity.ord f ↔ MvPolynomial.constantCoeff f = 0

Singularity.opOf.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field k] →
      (MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (MvPolynomial σ k)) → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.opOf_apply.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (MvPolynomial σ k)) (n : ℕ)
  (P : MvPolynomial σ k), (Singularity.opOf φ n) P = (φ P).coeff n

Singularity.optionElim_none.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (i : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.optionElim i d) none = i

Singularity.optionEquivLeft_rename_some.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) g) = Polynomial.C g

Singularity.optionEquivLeft_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) (Singularity.zMonic m a) =
    Polynomial.X ^ m + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * Polynomial.X ^ i

Singularity.optionEquivLeft_zMonic_coeff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ} {Q : Polynomial (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  Q.natDegree ≤ m → Q.coeff m = 1 → (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) (Singularity.zMonic m fun i => Q.coeff i) = Q

Singularity.optionEquivLeft_zShift.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (h : MvPolynomial σ R) (f : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) ((Singularity.zShift h) f) =
    (Polynomial.taylor h) ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) f)

Singularity.ord.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → ℕ∞

Singularity.ordAlong.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ R → ℕ∞

Singularity.ordAlong.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {inst_1 : DecidableEq σ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ]
  (S S_1 : Finset σ),
  S = S_1 → ∀ (f f_1 : MvPolynomial σ R), f = f_1 → Singularity.ordAlong S f = Singularity.ordAlong S_1 f_1

Singularity.ordAlong_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Nontrivial R] (S : Finset σ) (i : σ),
  Singularity.ordAlong S (MvPolynomial.X i) = ↑(if i ∈ S then 1 else 0)

Singularity.ordAlong_X_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Nontrivial R] (S : Finset σ) (i : σ)
  (n : ℕ), Singularity.ordAlong S (MvPolynomial.X i ^ n) = ↑(if i ∈ S then n else 0)

Singularity.ordAlong_add_pow_le_cleanOrd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) (S : Finset σ)
  (g h : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ordAlong S (g + h ^ p) ≤ Singularity.cleanOrdAlong p S g

Singularity.ordAlong_eq_iInf.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ordAlong S f = ⨅ d ∈ f.support, ↑(∑ i ∈ S, d i)

Singularity.ordAlong_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {d : σ →₀ ℕ}, f.coeff d ≠ 0 → Singularity.ordAlong S f ≤ ↑(∑ i ∈ S, d i)

Singularity.ordAlong_le_cleanOrdAlong.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {p : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (S : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ordAlong S g ≤ Singularity.cleanOrdAlong p S g

Singularity.ordAlong_le_ordAlong_X_mul_p.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (j : σ)
  (F : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ordAlong S F ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) F) + 1

Singularity.ordAlong_le_ordAlong_mul_lef.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ)
  (a f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ordAlong S f ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (a * f)

Singularity.ordAlong_le_ordAlong_pderiv_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (j : σ)
  (F : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ordAlong S F ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) F) + 1

Singularity.ordAlong_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : R},
  c ≠ 0 → Singularity.ordAlong S ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) c) = ↑(∑ i ∈ S, d i)

Singularity.ordAlong_monomial_mul_add_po.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (S : Finset σ)
  {Δ : Finset σ} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
    ∀ (G h : MvPolynomial σ k) {e : MvPolynomial σ k},
      e ∈
          (fun i => ↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G) '' ↑Δ ∪
            (fun j => (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G) '' (↑Δ)ᶜ →
        Singularity.ordAlong S ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G + h ^ p) ≤
          ↑(∑ i ∈ S, r i) + Singularity.ordAlong S e + 1

Singularity.ordAlong_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [NoZeroDivisors R] (S : Finset σ)
  (f g : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ordAlong S (f * g) = Singularity.ordAlong S f + Singularity.ordAlong S g

Singularity.ordAlong_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ),
  Singularity.ordAlong S 0 = ⊤

Singularity.ord_C.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {c : R}, c ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.C c) = 0

Singularity.ord_X.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (i : σ), Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X i) = 1

Singularity.ord_X_mul_X_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (i j : σ) (n : ℕ),
  Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j ^ n) = ↑(n + 1)

Singularity.ord_X_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (i : σ) (n : ℕ),
  Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X i ^ n) = ↑n

Singularity.ord_X_pow_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {i : σ} {n : ℕ} {q : MvPolynomial σ k},
  ↑n < Singularity.ord q → Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X i ^ n + q) = ↑n

Singularity.ord_add_of_lt.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Singularity.ord f < Singularity.ord g → Singularity.ord (f + g) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_add_of_ord_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Singularity.ord f ≠ Singularity.ord g → Singularity.ord (f + g) = min (Singularity.ord f) (Singularity.ord g)

Singularity.ord_add_pow_le_ord_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord (F + h ^ p ^ e) ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F)

Singularity.ord_add_pow_le_ord_of_isClea.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F → ∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ord (F + h ^ p ^ e) ≤ Singularity.ord F

Singularity.ord_add_pow_le_residualOrder.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord (F + h ^ q) ≤ Singularity.residualOrder q F

Singularity.ord_algEquiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {τ : Type u_3} (e : MvPolynomial σ R ≃ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R),
  (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (e (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
    (∀ (i : τ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (e.symm (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
      ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord (e f) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_centerChartUnit.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (S : Finset σ)
  (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (r : σ →₀ ℕ), Singularity.ord (Singularity.centerChartUnit S j t r) = 0

Singularity.ord_chartRest_monomial_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (r : σ →₀ ℕ),
  Singularity.ord ((Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1)) =
    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t r))

Singularity.ord_chartTransform_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {m : ℕ}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ k}, Singularity.ord f = ↑m → Singularity.ord (Singularity.chartTransform j t m f) ≤ ↑m

Singularity.ord_chartUnit.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (r : σ →₀ ℕ), Singularity.ord (Singularity.chartUnit j t r) = 0

Singularity.ord_cleanPart_add_le_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {e d : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k} {α : σ →₀ ℕ},
  F.coeff α ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.ord F = ↑(Finsupp.degree α) →
      Finsupp.degree α = Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
        ∀ {i : σ},
          i ≠ j →
            ¬p ^ e ∣ α i →
              (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * F' →
                ∃ v < e,
                  Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F') + ↑(p ^ e) ≤
                    ↑(p ^ v +
                        (Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) +
                              Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) +
                            d +
                          d))

Singularity.ord_cleanPart_add_le_of_not_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {e d : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k} {α : σ →₀ ℕ},
  F.coeff α ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.ord F = ↑(Finsupp.degree α) →
      Finsupp.degree α = Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
        ¬p ^ e ∣ Finsupp.degree α →
          (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * F' →
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F') + ↑(p ^ e) ≤
              ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) +
                      Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) +
                    d +
                  d)

Singularity.ord_def.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord f = (↑f).order

Singularity.ord_divMonomial_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ β ∈ P.support, r ≤ β) → Singularity.ord (P.divMonomial r) + ↑(Finsupp.degree r) = Singularity.ord P

Singularity.ord_eq_degree_divisorExponen.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord g =
    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.ord_eq_iInf_degree.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f = ⨅ d ∈ f.support, ↑(Finsupp.degree d)

Singularity.ord_eq_one_of_constantCoeff_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {G : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff G = 0 →
    ∀ {j : σ}, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G) ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord G = 1

Singularity.ord_eq_order_idealOfVars.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f = Singularity.Algebra.order (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R) f

Singularity.ord_eq_top_iff.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R}, Singularity.ord f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0

Singularity.ord_eq_zero_iff_constantCoef.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.ord f = 0 ↔ MvPolynomial.constantCoeff f ≠ 0

Singularity.ord_killOutside.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {s : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ s →
    Singularity.ord f = ↑s → Singularity.ord ((Singularity.killOutside S) f) = ↑s

Singularity.ord_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  f.coeff d ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord f ≤ ↑(Finsupp.degree d)

Singularity.ord_le_idealOrd_residualLogJ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord G ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ r G) + 1

Singularity.ord_le_of_centerChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ {t : σ → k} {s : ℕ} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k},
      f ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ s →
        Singularity.ord f = ↑s → (Singularity.centerChart S j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ s * f' → Singularity.ord f' ≤ ↑s

Singularity.ord_le_of_homogeneousCompone.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℕ},
  (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord f ≤ ↑m

Singularity.ord_le_of_pointChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ}, Singularity.ord f = ↑m → (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' → Singularity.ord f' ≤ ↑m

Singularity.ord_le_ord_aeval.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {τ : Type u_3} (φ : σ → MvPolynomial τ R),
  (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (φ i) = 0) →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.aeval φ) f)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord F ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart q F)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_killOutside.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.killOutside S) f)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_killVar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord g ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.killVar j) g)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_linearChange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (A : Matrix σ σ R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.linearChange A) f)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_rename_some.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord g ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.rename some) g)

Singularity.ord_le_residualOrder.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {q : ℕ},
  q ≠ 0 → ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ord F ≤ Singularity.residualOrder q F

Singularity.ord_le_totalDegree.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {p : MvPolynomial σ k}, p ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord p ≤ ↑p.totalDegree

Singularity.ord_linearChange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (A : Matrix σ σ R)
  [Invertible A] (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord ((Singularity.linearChange A) f) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : R},
  c ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) c) = ↑(Finsupp.degree d)

Singularity.ord_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord (f * g) = Singularity.ord f + Singularity.ord g

Singularity.ord_ne_top.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R}, f ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord f ≠ ⊤

Singularity.ord_neg.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord (-f) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_one.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R], Singularity.ord 1 = 0

Singularity.ord_pointChart_diag_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {F : MvPolynomial σ k} {S : MvPolynomial σ k →ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ k} {w : (σ →₀ ℕ) → k},
  Singularity.IsDiag S w →
    ∀ {α : σ →₀ ℕ} {d : ℕ},
      F.coeff α ≠ 0 →
        Singularity.ord F = ↑(Finsupp.degree α) →
          w α ≠ 0 →
            Finsupp.degree α = Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
              Singularity.ord ((Singularity.pointChart j t) (S F)) ≤
                ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) +
                        Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) +
                      d +
                    d)

Singularity.ord_pointChart_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {d : ℕ},
  (∀ β ∈ P.support, r ≤ β) →
    Singularity.ord P = ↑(Finsupp.degree r + d) →
      Singularity.ord ((Singularity.pointChart j t) P) ≤
        ↑(Finsupp.degree r + Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t r) + d + d)

Singularity.ord_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R)
  (n : ℕ), Singularity.ord (f ^ n) = n • Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_prod.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type u_3} (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, Singularity.ord (f i)

Singularity.ord_residualFactor_le_logJac.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≤ Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1

Singularity.ord_residualFactor_le_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = 0 → Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≤ 1

Singularity.ord_sum_smul_add_X_mul_pderi.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {G : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.ord G = ↑d →
    ↑(Finsupp.degree r + d) ≠ 0 →
      Singularity.ord (∑ i, (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G)) = ↑d

Singularity.ord_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R], Singularity.ord 0 = ⊤

Singularity.orderGAlong.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → Finset σ → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.orderGAlong_le_idealOrdAlong.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (Δ S : Finset σ)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ S g ≤
    Singularity.idealOrdAlong S
        (Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) +
      1

Singularity.orthant_add_orthant.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1}, Singularity.orthant σ + Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.orthant σ

Singularity.p1Structure.type:
(k : Type u) →
  [inst : Field k] →
    (p n : ℕ) → (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) → Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k

Singularity.p1_equation_ne_zero.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), MvPolynomial.X none ^ p + (MvPolynomial.rename some) g ≠ 0

Singularity.pderiv_X_pow_mul_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {i j : σ},
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (MvPolynomial.X j ^ n * u) = MvPolynomial.X j ^ n * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) u

Singularity.pderiv_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (j : σ) (g h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (g + h ^ p) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) g

Singularity.pderiv_centerChart_of_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i j : σ},
  i ∈ S →
    i ≠ j →
      ∀ (t : σ → k) (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
        (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) h) =
          MvPolynomial.X j * (Singularity.centerChart S j t) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.pderiv_centerChart_of_notMem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    i ∉ S →
      ∀ (t : σ → k) (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
        (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) h) =
          (Singularity.centerChart S j t) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.pderiv_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (i : σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.cleanPart p g) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g

Singularity.pderiv_eq_zero_of_mem_direct.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {F : MvPolynomial σ k} {v : σ → k} {i : σ} (c : k),
  v ∈ Singularity.directrix F →
    v ∈ Singularity.directrix (c • F + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) F) →
      v i ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) F = 0

Singularity.pderiv_mem_centerDegreeIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S n →
    ∀ (l : σ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) f ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S (n - if l ∈ S then 1 else 0)

Singularity.pderiv_mem_derivIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  f ∈ I → ∀ (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f ∈ Singularity.derivIdeal I

Singularity.pderiv_mem_logJacobian.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∉ Δ → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ k), (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) g ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g

Singularity.pderiv_mem_logJacobianCenter.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ S : Finset σ} {l : σ},
  l ∉ Δ → l ∉ S → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ k), (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) g ∈ Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g

Singularity.pderiv_mem_residualLogJacobi.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∉ Δ → ∀ (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k), (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ r G

Singularity.pderiv_monomial_eq_zero_of_d.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ (i : σ), p ∣ a i) → ∀ (c : k) (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) = 0

Singularity.pderiv_monomial_mul_of_eq_ze.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {j : σ},
  r j = 0 →
    ∀ (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) =
        (MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G

Singularity.pderiv_ne_zero_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (F : MvPolynomial σ k) (j : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) F ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ a ∈ F.support, ¬p ∣ a j

Singularity.pderiv_none_purelyInseparabl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv none) (Singularity.purelyInseparable p h) = 0

Singularity.pderiv_none_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv none) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) h) = 0

Singularity.pderiv_pointChart_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {i j : σ},
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) h) =
        MvPolynomial.X j * (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.pderiv_some_purelyInseparabl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial σ k) (i : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv (some i)) (Singularity.purelyInseparable q h) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename some) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.pderiv_some_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (v : σ → k) (i : σ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv (some i)) ((Singularity.translate v) F) = (Singularity.translate v) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) F)

Singularity.pointChart.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.pointChartZ.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.pointChartZ_purelyInseparabl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {q : ℕ}
  {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ q * F' →
    (Singularity.pointChartZ j t) (Singularity.purelyInseparable q F) =
      MvPolynomial.X (some j) ^ q * Singularity.purelyInseparable q F'

Singularity.pointChartZ_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.pointChartZ j t) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) F) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename some) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) F)

Singularity.pointChart_X_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (i : σ),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X j * (Singularity.chartRest j t) (MvPolynomial.X i)

Singularity.pointChart_X_mul_pderiv_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ]
  (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k) (m : σ),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) ∈
    Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) g)

Singularity.pointChart_X_mul_pderiv_of_n.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {m j : σ},
  m ≠ j →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) =
        (MvPolynomial.X m + MvPolynomial.C (t m)) * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k} {i : σ},
  i ≠ j →
    t i = 0 →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g) =
          MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g')

Singularity.pointChart_X_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j i : σ} (t : σ → k),
  i ≠ j → (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (t i))

Singularity.pointChart_X_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X j) = MvPolynomial.X j

Singularity.pointChart_eq_sum.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) f =
    ∑ a ∈ f.support,
      MvPolynomial.X j ^ Finsupp.degree a * (Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) (f.coeff a))

Singularity.pointChart_injective.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Function.Injective ⇑(Singularity.pointChart j t)

Singularity.pointChart_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) =
    MvPolynomial.X j ^ Finsupp.degree a * (Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c)

Singularity.pointChart_monomial_mul_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {m : ℕ} {ψ ψ' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) ψ = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * ψ' →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * ψ) =
      MvPolynomial.X j ^ (Finsupp.degree r + m) *
        ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t r)) 1 * (Singularity.chartUnit j t r * ψ'))

Singularity.pointChart_ne_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ≠ 0 → (Singularity.pointChart j t) f ≠ 0

Singularity.pointChart_some_eq_pointChar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) {t : Option σ → k},
  t none = 0 → Singularity.pointChart (some j) t = Singularity.pointChartZ j fun l => t (some l)

Singularity.pointChart_some_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : Option σ → k)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.pointChart (some j) t) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) g) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename some) ((Singularity.pointChart j fun l => t (some l)) g)

Singularity.pointChart_sum_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Fintype σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p]
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) (∑ i, MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g) =
      MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * (MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) g')

Singularity.pointChart_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {m : ℕ} {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ i < m, ↑(m - i) ≤ Singularity.ord (a i)) →
    ∀ (j : σ) {t : Option σ → k},
      t none = 0 →
        (Singularity.pointChart (some j) t) (Singularity.zMonic m a) =
          MvPolynomial.X (some j) ^ m *
            Singularity.zMonic m fun i => Singularity.chartTransform j (fun l => t (some l)) (m - i) (a i)

Singularity.pointChart_zero_comp_chartLi.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j 0).comp (Singularity.chartLinear j t) = Singularity.pointChart j t

Singularity.pointIdeal.type: {ι : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → (ι → R) → Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)

Singularity.pow_eq_zero_of_isClean.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) {F h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F → Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) → h ^ p ^ e = 0

Singularity.pow_varsIdeal_le_alongIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Nontrivial R] (S : Finset σ) (n : ℕ),

{K : Type u_1} →

Singularity.projPoints.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → Set (σ → ℝ)

Singularity.projPoints_X_pow_add_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (G : MvPowerSeries σ k),
      Singularity.projPoints (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C G) =
        {u | ∃ α, (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) G ≠ 0 ∧ u = (↑n)⁻¹ • Singularity.expToReal α}

Singularity.projPoints_subset_projPolyhe.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.projPoints f ⊆ Singularity.projPolyhedron f

Singularity.projPoints_taylor_monomial_s.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  Singularity.projPoints ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial β) c)) f) ⊆
    (convexHull ℝ) (Singularity.projPolyhedron f ∪ ({Singularity.expToReal β} + Singularity.orthant σ))

Singularity.projPolyhedron.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → Set (σ → ℝ)

Singularity.projPolyhedron_X_pow_add_C_c.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C ↑F) = (↑n)⁻¹ • Singularity.newtonPolyhedron F

Singularity.projPolyhedron_add_orthant.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.projPolyhedron f + Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.projPolyhedron f

Singularity.projPolyhedron_subset_taylor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [Nontrivial k] (e : ℕ)
  {F : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  (∀ (α : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) F ≠ 0 → ¬∀ (i : σ), p ^ e ∣ α i) →
    ∀ (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k),
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C F) ⊆
        Singularity.projPolyhedron ((Polynomial.taylor φ) (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C F))

Singularity.projPolyhedron_taylor_monomi.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  Singularity.projPolyhedron ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial β) c)) f) ⊆
    (convexHull ℝ) (Singularity.projPolyhedron f ∪ ({Singularity.expToReal β} + Singularity.orthant σ))

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {β : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Singularity.expToReal β ∈ Singularity.projPolyhedron f →
    ∀ (c : k),
      Singularity.projPolyhedron ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial β) c)) f) ⊆ Singularity.projPolyhedron f

Singularity.projPolyhedron_taylor_ssubse.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : k},
  Singularity.expToReal v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) →
    Singularity.IsSolvableVertex f v c →
      Singularity.projPolyhedron ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial v) (-c))) f) ⊂
        Singularity.projPolyhedron f
