Singularity.purelyInseparableExtension.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  {L : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field K] →
      [inst_1 : Field L] →
        [inst_2 : Algebra K L] →
          (p : ℕ) → [ExpChar K p] → [IsPurelyInseparable K L] → ValuationSubring K → ValuationSubring L

Singularity.purelyInseparableHypersurfac.type: ∀ {p n : ℕ}, p ≠ 0 → Singularity.ResolutionInDim p n → Singularity.PurelyInseparableHypersurfaceResolution p n

Singularity.purelyInseparable_mem_pointI.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (G : MvPolynomial σ k) (x : σ → k)
  (c : k),
  c ^ p = (MvPolynomial.eval x) G →
    (MvPolynomial.X none ^ p - (MvPolynomial.rename some) G ∈ (Singularity.pointIdeal fun o => o.elim c x) ^ 2 ↔
      ∀ (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G) = 0)

∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (a b c : k),
  c ^ p = (MvPolynomial.eval ![a, b]) G →
    (MvPolynomial.X none ^ p - (MvPolynomial.rename some) G ∈ (Singularity.pointIdeal fun o => o.elim c ![a, b]) ^ 2 ↔
      (MvPolynomial.eval ![a, b]) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv 0) G) = 0 ∧
        (MvPolynomial.eval ![a, b]) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv 1) G) = 0)

Singularity.rankOne_iff_mulArchimedean.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] [Nontrivial G],
  (⊥ ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ (H : Subgroup G), Singularity.IsConvexSubgroup H → H = ⊥ ∨ H = ⊤) ↔ MulArchimedean G

Singularity.rank_int_valueGroup_add_trde.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (A : ValuationSubring K) {k : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field k] [inst_2 : Algebra k K]
  [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥A] [IsScalarTower k (↥A) K],
  Module.rank ℤ (Additive A.ValueGroupˣ) + Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K

Singularity.rank_int_valueGroup_map_add_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type uL} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} {Γ₁ : Type uΓ}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vK : Valuation K Γ₀)
  (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL],
  Cardinal.lift.{uL, uΓ}
        (Module.rank ℤ
          (Additive
            ↥(Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) (↑vL).valueGroup))) +
      Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL}
        (Algebra.trdeg (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vL.valuationSubring)) ≤
    Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL} (Algebra.trdeg K L)

Singularity.rank_le_and_ringKrullDim_le_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) {k : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field k] [inst_2 : Algebra k K]
  [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {d : ℕ},
  Algebra.trdeg k K = ↑d →
    Module.rank ℚ (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ (Additive V.ValueGroupˣ)) ≤ ↑d ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V) ≤ ↑d ∧
        Finite { H // Singularity.IsConvexSubgroup H } ∧
          Nat.card { H // Singularity.IsConvexSubgroup H } - 1 ≤ d ∧ ringKrullDim ↥V ≤ ↑d

Singularity.ratFunc_pow_ne_X.type: ∀ {K : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] {n : ℕ}, 2 ≤ n → ∀ (g : RatFunc K), g ^ n ≠ RatFunc.X

Singularity.reflTransGen_macLaneVaquieSt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w₀ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c : K), ν (Polynomial.C c) = w₀ (Polynomial.C c)) →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w₀ f) →
      w₀ ≠ ν → (Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) w₀ ν ↔ ∃ φ, Singularity.KeyPolynomial ν φ)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w₀ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c : K), ν (Polynomial.C c) = w₀ (Polynomial.C c)) →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w₀ f) →
      ∀ {φ : Polynomial K},
        φ.Monic →
          0 < φ.natDegree → Singularity.IsMuMinimal ν φ → Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) w₀ ν

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w₀ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c : K), ν (Polynomial.C c) = w₀ (Polynomial.C c)) →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w₀ f) →
      ∀ {F : Polynomial K}, F ≠ 0 → ν F = 0 → Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) w₀ ν

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w₀ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c : K), ν (Polynomial.C c) = w₀ (Polynomial.C c)) →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w₀ f) →
      Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) w₀ ν ∨
        (∀ (φ : Polynomial K), ¬Singularity.KeyPolynomial ν φ) ∧
          ((∃ w,
              w 0 = w₀ ∧
                (∀ (n : ℕ), Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) (w n) (w (n + 1))) ∧
                  (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial K), f.natDegree ≤ n → (w n) f = ν f) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), w n ≠ ν) ∨
            ∃ μ,
              Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) w₀ μ ∧
                μ ≠ ν ∧
                  ∃ ι x,
                    ∃ (_ : Nonempty ι) (_ : NoMaxOrder ι),
                      ∃ F,
                        (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K),
                            ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) ∧
                          (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) ∧
                            ∀ (f : Polynomial K), F.IsStable f ∧ F.stableValue f = ν f)

Singularity.reflTransGen_monomialValuati.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {v : Valuation K Γ₀},
  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {F : Polynomial K},
      F ≠ 0 →
        ν F = 0 →
          Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) (Singularity.monomialValuation v (ν Polynomial.X)) ν

  [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f], IsOpen (Singularity.regularLocus X)

Singularity.relfinrank_sup_adjoin_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ)
  [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP K p] (M : IntermediateField K L) {θ : L},
  θ ∉ M → θ ^ p ∈ M → M.relfinrank (M ⊔ K⟮θ⟯) = p

Singularity.residualFactor.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.residualFactor_monomial_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {G : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
    (∀ i ∈ Δ, ∃ d ∈ G.support, d i = 0) → Singularity.residualFactor Δ ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) = G

Singularity.residualLogJacobian.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ k → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.residualLogJacobianTangent.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → Finset σ → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ k → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.residualLogJacobian_le_pow_v.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ S : Finset σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n + 1 ≤ Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ S g →
    Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≤
      Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ n

Singularity.residualLogJacobian_not_le_s.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ∀ {i : σ},
        i ∈ Δ →
          ¬Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≤
              Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X i}

Singularity.residualOrder.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.residualOrderAlong.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_add_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ' : Finset σ} {q B : ℕ} {F' : MvPolynomial σ k} {N : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ', N i = 0) →
    (∀ β ∈ F'.support, N ≤ β) →
      Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart q F') + ↑q ≤ ↑B →
        Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ' q F' + ↑(Finsupp.degree N + q) ≤ ↑B

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (Δ : Finset σ) (e : ℕ)
  (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) = Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) F

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                (∀ i ∈ Δ, i ≠ j → t i = 0) →
                  Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) p g' ≤
                    Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_empty.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.residualOrderAlong ∅ q F = Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart q F)

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {q : ℕ} {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {G : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean q ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) →
    (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
      (∀ i ∈ Δ, ∃ d ∈ G.support, d i = 0) →
        Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ q ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) = Singularity.ord G

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_le_logJac.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g ≤ Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_le_of_bou.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {e d n : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F →
    Singularity.ord (F.divMonomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) = ↑d →
      p ^ e ≤ Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * F' →
          Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F') + ↑(p ^ e) ≤
              ↑(n +
                  (Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) +
                        Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) +
                      d +
                    d)) →
            Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (p ^ e) F' ≤
              Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) F + ↑n

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_pointChar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {e : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F →
    ↑(p ^ e) ≤ Singularity.ord F →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * F' →
        Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (p ^ e) F' ≤
          Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) F + ↑(p ^ (e - 1))

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) p g' ≤
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') + 1 ∧
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') + 1 ≤
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1 ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1 ≤ Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g + 1

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)

    Polynomial.C ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.erase i β)) c) *

Singularity.taylorVar_pointChart.type:

      (Singularity.taylorVar i) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) P) =
        (Polynomial.map (↑(Singularity.pointChart j t)) ((Singularity.taylorVar i) P)).comp
          (Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X j) * Polynomial.X)

      ∀ {u : k},
        ↑f.natDegree * u = 1 →
          ∀ {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
            Singularity.expToReal v ∈
                Set.extremePoints ℝ
                  (Singularity.projPolyhedron
                    ((Polynomial.taylor (-(f.coeff (f.natDegree - 1) * MvPowerSeries.C u))) f)) →

                    v c

Singularity.tschirnhausen_pointChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {m : ℕ},
  ↑m ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k},
      a (m - 1) = 0 →
        (∀ i < m, ↑(m - i) ≤ Singularity.ord (a i)) →
          ∀ {c : Option σ} {t : Option σ → k} {f' : MvPolynomial (Option σ) k},
            (Singularity.pointChart c t) (Singularity.zMonic m a) = MvPolynomial.X c ^ m * f' →
              ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f' →
                ∃ j,
                  c = some j ∧
                    t none = 0 ∧
                      ∃ a',
                        f' = Singularity.zMonic m a' ∧
                          a' (m - 1) = 0 ∧
                            (∀ i < m, ↑(m - i) ≤ Singularity.ord (a' i)) ∧
                              ∀ i < m,
                                (Singularity.pointChart j fun l => t (some l)) (a i) = MvPolynomial.X j ^ (m - i) * a' i

Singularity.tschirnhausen_transformation.type:

  ∃ a',
    (Singularity.zShift (-(MvPolynomial.C ↑hm.unit⁻¹ * a (m - 1)))) (Singularity.zMonic m a) = Singularity.zMonic m a' ∧
      a' (m - 1) = 0

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K),
  (∀ (W : Subring K), V.toSubring ≤ W → ∃ W', W'.toSubring = W) ∧
    (∀ (I J : Ideal ↥V), I ≤ J ∨ J ≤ I) ∧
      (∀ (I : Ideal ↥V), I.FG → Submodule.IsPrincipal I) ∧
        IsIntegrallyClosed ↥V ∧ (IsNoetherianRing ↥V → V ≠ ⊤ → IsDiscreteValuationRing ↥V)

Singularity.valuation_aeval_divX_iterate.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) {R : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra R K]
  (f : Polynomial R) {β : K},
  β ∈ V →
    ∀ (m : ℕ),
      (∀ (i : ℕ), m ≤ i → V.valuation ((algebraMap R K) (f.coeff i)) < 1) →
        V.valuation ((Polynomial.aeval β) (Polynomial.divX^[m] f)) < 1

Singularity.valuation_apply_lt_one_iff.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {W : ValuationSubring L}
  {σ : Gal(L/K)}, (∀ (x : L), σ x ∈ W ↔ x ∈ W) → ∀ (x : L), W.valuation (σ x) < 1 ↔ W.valuation x < 1

Singularity.valuation_basic_properties.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] (v : Valuation K Γ₀)
  {ι : Type u_3} [DecidableEq ι],
  v 1 = 1 ∧
    v (-1) = 1 ∧
      (∀ (x : K), v (-x) = v x) ∧
        (∀ (x : K), v x⁻¹ = (v x)⁻¹) ∧
          (∀ (x y : K), v x ≠ v y → v (x + y) = max (v x) (v y)) ∧
            ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K), ∀ i ∈ s, (∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ i → v (f j) < v (f i)) → v (∑ j ∈ s, f j) = v (f i)

Singularity.valuation_comap_eq_one_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} {K' : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field K'] (V : ValuationSubring K') (f : K →+* K') (x : K),
  (V.comap f).valuation x = 1 ↔ V.valuation (f x) = 1

Singularity.valuation_comap_lt_one_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] (W : ValuationSubring L) (f : K →+* L) (x : K),
  (W.comap f).valuation x < 1 ↔ W.valuation (f x) < 1

Singularity.valuation_eq_max_of_ne.type:
∀ {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {R : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Ring R] (v : Valuation R Γ₀)
  {x y : R}, v x ≠ v (x + y) → v y = max (v x) (v (x + y))

Singularity.valuation_eq_one_iff_mem.type: ∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (x : K), V.valuation x = 1 ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ V ∧ x⁻¹ ∈ V

Singularity.valuation_eq_one_iff_mem_inv.type: ∀ {L : Type u_5} [inst : Field L] (A : ValuationSubring L) {c : L}, c ≠ 0 → (A.valuation c = 1 ↔ c ∈ A ∧ c⁻¹ ∈ A)

Singularity.valuation_eq_one_of_mem.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K}
  {F : IntermediateField k K}, (∀ c ∈ F, c ∈ V) → ∀ {c : K}, c ∈ F → c ≠ 0 → V.valuation c = 1

Singularity.valuation_eq_one_of_not_mem_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {hA : A ≤ V.toSubring} {a : ↥A},
  a ∉ Singularity.centerIdeal V A hA → V.valuation ↑a = 1

Singularity.valuation_eq_one_of_residue_.type:
∀ {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field L] {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vL : Valuation L Γ₁)
  {x : ↥vL.valuationSubring}, (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) x ≠ 0 → vL ↑x = 1

Singularity.valuation_eq_one_of_valuatio.type:
∀ {L : Type u_1} {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : Ring L] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] (v : Valuation L Γ₀)
  {n : ℕ}, 2 ≤ n → ∀ {η : L}, v (η ^ n - η) = 1 → v η = 1

Singularity.valuation_inv_smul_lt_one_if.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (σ : Gal(L/K))
  (W : ValuationSubring L) (x : L), (σ⁻¹ • W).valuation x < 1 ↔ W.valuation (σ x) < 1

Singularity.valuation_lt_one_iff_eq_zero.type: ∀ {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field L] (W : ValuationSubring L) (x : L), W.valuation x < 1 ↔ x = 0 ∨ x⁻¹ ∉ W

Singularity.valuation_ne_zero_of_ne_zero.type: ∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) {z : K}, z ≠ 0 → V.valuation z ≠ 0

Singularity.valuation_pow_eq_of_one_lt_v.type:
∀ {L : Type u_1} {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : Ring L] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] (v : Valuation L Γ₀)
  {n : ℕ}, 2 ≤ n → ∀ {η : L}, 1 < v (η ^ n - η) → v η ^ n = v (η ^ n - η)

Singularity.valuation_pow_sub_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {w : Valuation L Γ₀} {z : L},
  z ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {l m : ℕ},
      l < m →
        ∀ {a b : K},
          a ≠ 0 →
            w ((algebraMap K L) a * z ^ m) = w ((algebraMap K L) b * z ^ l) →
              w (z ^ (m - l)) = w ((algebraMap K L) (b / a))

Singularity.valuation_pow_sub_self_le_on.type:
∀ {L : Type u_1} {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : Ring L] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] (v : Valuation L Γ₀)
  {n : ℕ} {η : L}, v η ≤ 1 → v (η ^ n - η) ≤ 1

Singularity.valuation_pow_sub_self_of_on.type:
∀ {L : Type u_1} {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : Ring L] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] (v : Valuation L Γ₀)
  {n : ℕ}, 2 ≤ n → ∀ {η : L}, 1 < v η → v (η ^ n - η) = v η ^ n

Singularity.valuation_prod_sub_one_lt_on.type:
∀ {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field L] {ι : Type u_3} (W : ValuationSubring L) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → L),
  (∀ i ∈ s, W.valuation (f i - 1) < 1) → W.valuation (∏ i ∈ s, f i - 1) < 1

Singularity.valuation_sum_mul_le.type:
∀ {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {R : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Ring R] (v : Valuation R Γ₀)
  {ι : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} {F : ι → R} {c C : Γ₀}, (∀ i ∈ s, v (F i) * c ≤ C) → v (∑ i ∈ s, F i) * c ≤ C

Singularity.valuation_sum_mul_lt.type:
∀ {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {R : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Ring R] (v : Valuation R Γ₀)
  {ι : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} {F : ι → R} {c C : Γ₀}, 0 < C → (∀ i ∈ s, v (F i) * c < C) → v (∑ i ∈ s, F i) * c < C

Singularity.varsIdeal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → Finset σ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.vertexPoly.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → Polynomial k

Singularity.vertexPoly_X_pow_add_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (F : MvPowerSeries σ k) (v : σ →₀ ℕ),
      Singularity.vertexPoly (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C F) v =
        Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C ((MvPowerSeries.coeff (n • v)) F)

Singularity.vertexPoly_ne_X_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Singularity.expToReal v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) →
    Singularity.vertexPoly f v ≠ Polynomial.X ^ f.natDegree

Singularity.vertexPoly_taylor_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (v : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  Singularity.vertexPoly ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial v) c)) f) v =
    (Polynomial.taylor c) (Singularity.vertexPoly f v)

Singularity.vertexPoly_taylor_of_isSolva.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : k},
  Singularity.IsSolvableVertex f v c →
    Singularity.vertexPoly ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial v) (-c))) f) v = Polynomial.X ^ f.natDegree

Singularity.weight_alongWeight.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Finsupp.weight (Singularity.alongWeight S)) d = ∑ i ∈ S, d i

Singularity.weightedOrd.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → ℕ∞

Singularity.weightedOrd_eq_top_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Singularity.weightedOrd w f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0

Singularity.weightedOrd_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  f.coeff d ≠ 0 → Singularity.weightedOrd w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

Singularity.weightedOrd_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.weightedOrd w (f * g) = Singularity.weightedOrd w f + Singularity.weightedOrd w g

Singularity.weightedOrd_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.weightedOrd (fun x => 1) f = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.whitneyNormalization.type: (k : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing k] → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_X0.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k],
  (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 0) = MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_X1.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k], (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 1) = MvPolynomial.X 0

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_X1_mul.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k],
  MvPolynomial.X 1 * (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 1) =
    (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 0)

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_X1_sq.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k], MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 = (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 2)

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_X2.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k], (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 2) = MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_equatio.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k],
  (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 2 - MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 2) = 0

Singularity.whitney_exists_eq_add_mul.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k] (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
  ∃ a b, g = (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) a + (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) b * MvPolynomial.X 1

Singularity.whitney_lineChart_x.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x₂ y z : R), (y * x₂) ^ 2 - y ^ 2 * z = y ^ 2 * (x₂ ^ 2 - z)

Singularity.whitney_lineChart_y.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₃ z : R), x ^ 2 - (x * y₃) ^ 2 * z = x ^ 2 * (1 - y₃ ^ 2 * z)

Singularity.whitney_pointChart_z.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x₁ y₁ z : R), (z * x₁) ^ 2 - (z * y₁) ^ 2 * z = z ^ 2 * (x₁ ^ 2 - y₁ ^ 2 * z)

Singularity.xTranslate.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → (σ → R) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial (Option σ) R

Singularity.xTranslate_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (b : σ → R) (g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.xTranslate b) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) g) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename some) ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun l => MvPolynomial.X l + MvPolynomial.C (b l)) g)

Singularity.xTranslate_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (b : σ → R) (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.xTranslate b) (Singularity.zMonic m a) =
    Singularity.zMonic m fun i => (MvPolynomial.aeval fun l => MvPolynomial.X l + MvPolynomial.C (b l)) (a i)

Singularity.zMonic.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → ℕ → (ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) R

Singularity.zMonic_narasimhanCoeff.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K],
  Singularity.zMonic 2 (Singularity.narasimhanCoeff K) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑(finSuccEquiv 3)) (Singularity.Examples.narasimhanF K)

Singularity.zShift.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.zShift_purelyInseparable.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (h F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.zShift h) (Singularity.purelyInseparable (p ^ e) F) =
    Singularity.purelyInseparable (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e)

Singularity.zShift_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (h F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.zShift h) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) F) = (MvPolynomial.rename some) F

Singularity.zShift_zero_apply.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (f : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R), (Singularity.zShift 0) f = f
